records.lg: Overwhelmed by Asencia's mysteriously advanced weaponry, the Protostar and Voyager crews take a series of calculated risks that endanger the cadets.
As war looms between the Federation and Solum, Gwyn proposes to lead the cadets on an undercover mission to gather intelligence and rescue Ilthuran.
Admiral Janeway devises a clever plan to liberate her crew from Asencia's prison, where they're trapped with an angry captive from the Loom.
Twelve-year-old classmates Kima and Lil find themselves at odds with each other on a day that will change their lives forever.
The cadets fight Asencia in a battle for control of Solum and the future – but a sudden invasion by a destructive species complicates their end-game.
A desperate Asencia launches an all-out attack on the Federation that will destroy subspace, while Wesley and the cadets try to correct the timeline.

At the end of the 24th century, and fourteen years after his retirement from Starfleet, Jean-Luc Picard is living a quiet life on his vineyard, Château Picard. When he is sought out by a mysterious young woman, Dahj, in need of his help, he soon realizes she may have personal connections to his own past.

Picard begins investigating the mystery of Dahj as well as what her very existence means to the Federation. Without Starfleet's support, Picard is left leaning on others for help, including Dr. Agnes Jurati and an estranged former colleague, Raffi Musiker. Meanwhile, hidden enemies are also interested in where Picard's search for the truth about Dahj will lead.

Completely unaware of her special nature, Soji continues her work and captures the attention of the Borg cube research project's executive director. After rehashing past events with a reluctant Raffi, Picard seeks others willing to join his search for Bruce Maddox, including pilot and former Starfleet officer Cristóbal Rios.

The crew's journey to Freecloud takes a detour when Picard orders a stop at the planet Vashti, where Picard and Musiker relocated Romulan refugees fourteen years earlier. Upon arrival, Picard reunites with Elnor, a young Romulan he befriended during the relocation. Meanwhile, Narek continues his attempts to learn more about Soji while Narissa's impatience with his lack of progress grows.

The La Sirena crew begins an unpredictable and lively expedition on Freecloud to search for Bruce Maddox. When they learn that Maddox has found himself in a precarious situation, a familiar face offers her assistance.
Picard and the crew track Soji to the Borg cube in Romulan space, resurfacing haunting memories for Picard. Meanwhile, Narek believes he finally found a way to safely exploit Soji for information.

Picard and Soji transport to the planet Nepenthe, home to some old and trusted friends. As the rest of La Sirenas crew attempt to join them, Picard helps Soji make sense of her recently unlocked memories. Meanwhile, Hugh and Elnor are left on the Borg cube and must face an angered Narissa.

When devastating truths behind the Mars attack are revealed, Picard realizes just how far many will go to preserve secrets stretching back generations, all while La Sirena crew grapples with secrets and revelations of their own. Narissa directs her guards to capture Elnor, setting off an unexpected chain of events on the Borg cube.

Following an unconventional and dangerous transit, Picard and the crew finally arrive at Soji's home world, Coppelius. However, with Romulan warbirds on their tail, their arrival brings only greater danger as the crew discovers more than expected about the planet's inhabitants.
Picard and his team are pitted against the Romulans and the synthetics of Coppelius in a final confrontation.

Starfleet must once again call on legendary Jean-Luc Picard after members of his former crew – Cristóbal Rios, Seven of Nine, Raffi Musiker, and Dr. Agnes Jurati – discover an anomaly in space that threatens the galaxy.
Vadic forces Picard to make an impossible choice – deliver what he can never give... or watch his crew perish. Their only salvation lies in the mind of an old friend and old foe.

A devastating revelation about Jack alters the course of Picard's life forever – and uncovers a truth that threatens every soul in the Federation. The final battle begins as Picard and his crew race to save the galaxy from annihilation – but not without a gut-wrenching cost.

Now on the run, Picard and the skeleton crew of the USS Titan must break into Starfleet's most top-secret facility to expose a plot that could destroy the Federation. Picard must turn to the only soul in the galaxy who can help – an old friend.

Aided by Seven of Nine and the crew of the USS Titan, Picard makes a shocking discovery that will alter his life forever – and puts him on a collision course with the most cunning enemy he's ever encountered. Meanwhile, Raffi races to track a catastrophic weapon – and collides with a familiar ally.

Crippled, cornered, and out of options, Picard stages a gambit to trap Vadic and reveal her true motive – a gamble that puts the Titan in the crosshairs and forces Picard and Beverly to question every moral code they've ever held.

Caught by Starfleet and facing court martial, paranoia grows as Picard struggles to uncover whether a prodigal crewman from his past has returned as an ally – or an enemy hellbent on destroying them all.

In a desperate last stand, Jean-Luc Picard and generations of crews both old and new fight together to save the galaxy from the greatest threat they've ever faced as the saga of Star Trek: The Next Generation comes to a thrilling, epic conclusion.

After receiving a cryptic, urgent distress call from Dr. Beverly Crusher, Admiral Jean-Luc Picard enlists help from generations old and new to embark on one final adventure: a daring mission that will change Starfleet, and his old crew forever.

With time running out, Picard, Riker and crew must confront the sins of their past and heal fresh wounds, while the Titan, dead in the water, drifts helplessly toward certain destruction within a mysterious space anomaly.

Picard grapples with an explosive, life-altering revelation, while the Titan and her crew try to outmaneuver a relentless Vadic in a lethal game of nautical cat and mouse. Meanwhile, Raffi and Worf uncover a nefarious plot from a vengeful enemy Starfleet has long since forgotten.

Picard finds himself transported to an alternate timeline in the year 2400 [sic] where his longtime nemesis, Q, has orchestrated one final "trial." Picard searches for his trusted crew as he attempts to find the cause of this dystopian future.

Picard and the crew travel back to 2024 Los Angeles in search of the "Watcher," who can help them identify the point at which time diverged. Seven, Raffi, and Rios venture out into an unfamiliar world four hundred years in their past, while Picard and Jurati attempt to gather information from an unlikely, and dangerous, ally.
Although separated by decades, the Infinity and the Voyager crews band together to save Gwyn's life. A mysterious messenger reaches out to Gwyn.

Reactivated after lying inactive for seven hundred years, a backup version of the Doctor tries to uncover the truth about war crimes supposedly committed by Voyager when they passed a planet centuries ago.
Burnham navigates a strange, new galaxy, 930 years in her future, looking for the rest of the Discovery crew.

After the USS Discovery crash-lands on a strange planet, the crew finds themselves racing against time to repair their ship. Meanwhile, Saru and Tilly embark on a perilous first-contact mission in hopes of finding Burnham.
Reunited with Burnham, Discovery heads to Earth to find out what has happened to the Federation in the last thousand years.
Burnham and Adira visit the Trill homeworld while Saru's efforts on the Discovery to help the crew reconnect yield surprises.
After reuniting with what remains of Starfleet and the Federation, the USS Discovery and its crew must prove that a 930 year old crew and starship are exactly what this new future needs.

After receiving a message from Book, Burnham and Georgiou embark on a rogue mission to find him, leaving Saru to pick up the pieces with Admiral Vance. Meanwhile, Stamets forms an unexpected bond with Adira.

While grappling with the fallout of her recent actions, and what her future might hold, Burnham agrees to represent the Federation in an intense debate about the release of politically sensitive – but highly valuable – Burn data.

Burnham and the USS Discovery crew travel to Book's home planet to help rescue it from Osyraa, the formidable leader of the Emerald Chain. Meanwhile, Stamets and Adira continue their search for valuable information on the origin of the Burn.

The USS Discovery crew journeys to a mysterious planet in hopes of finding a cure for Georgiou's deteriorating condition. Stamets and Adira make a stunning breakthrough with the newly acquired Burn data.
Georgiou uncovers the true depths of the plot against her, leading her to a revelation about how deeply her time on the USS Discovery truly changed her.
Discovery ventures to the Verubin Nebula, where Burnham, Saru, and Culber make a shocking realization about the origin of The Burn as the rest of the crew faces an unexpected threat.
After capturing the USS Discovery, Osyraa seeks a meeting with Admiral Vance while Burnham and the crew must overcome unimaginable odds as they attempt to regain command of their ship.
As the Emerald Chain tightens its grip and the mystery of the Burn is finally solved, Burnham and the crew have one last chance to save themselves – and the Federation.

After months spent reconnecting the Federation with distant worlds, Captain Michael Burnham and the crew of the USS Discovery are sent to assist a damaged space station – a seemingly routine mission that reveals the existence of a terrifying new threat.
Saru returns to help the USS Discovery uncover the mystery of an unusually destructive new force. As Burnham leads the crew, she must also find a way to help Book cope with an unimaginable loss.
Burnham and Tilly hunt the killer of a Starfleet officer as Stamets and the science team race against the clock to prevent the anomaly from killing anyone else.
Tilly and Adira lead a team of Starfleet Academy cadets on a training mission that takes a dangerous turn. Meanwhile, Burnham is pulled into tense negotiations on Ni'Var.

Burnham and Book race to evacuate a group of stranded colonists in the anomaly's path as one of the Federation's brightest scientists comes aboard the USS Discovery to do high-stakes research with Saru and Stamets.
Seeking answers, the USS Discovery ventures into a subspace rift created by the Dark Matter Anomaly. Meanwhile, Book faces a strange visitor from his past.
Tensions rise as representatives from across the galaxy gather to confront the threat of the Dark Matter Anomaly. Zora's new sentience raises difficult questions.
Following a hunch, Captain Burnham tracks Book to an old haunt from their courier days and gets drawn into a high-stakes competition for a powerful weapon.
Captain Burnham and the USS Discovery race to stop Book and Ruon Tarka from launching a rogue plan that could inadvertently endanger the galaxy.
Captain Burnham and her crew must go where few have gone before: beyond the Galactic Barrier. Meanwhile, Book learns the truth of what drives Ruon Tarka.
While Captain Burnham leads an away mission to a planet that was once home to the aliens responsible for the DMA, Book and Tarka secretly infiltrate the USS Discovery.
As the DMA approaches Earth and Ni'Var, Captain Burnham and the crew of the USS Discovery attempt to make first contact with the powerful species responsible before it's too late.

The DMA approaches Earth and Ni'Var. With evacuations underway, Burnham and the team aboard the USS Discovery must find a way to communicate and connect with a species far different from their own before time runs out.

Captain Burnham and the USS Discovery are sent to retrieve a mysterious 800-year-old Romulan vessel; until the artifact hidden inside is stolen, leading to an epic chase. Meanwhile, Saru is offered the position of a lifetime, and Tilly's efforts to help pull her into a tangled web of secrecy.
On Saru's last mission as Captain Burnham's Number One, the team ventures to a seemingly abandoned planet to hunt for what might be the greatest treasure in the galaxy.

On Trill, Burnham, Booker, and Culber must pass a dangerous test to prove themselves worthy of the next clue. Adira reconnects with Gray, and Saru's first day as ambassador is complicated by his engagement to T'Rina.
On the way to the next clue, the USS Discovery is sabotaged by a mysterious weapon, leaving Captain Burnham, Rayner, and Stamets as the only crew members who can possibly save the ship in time.

Captain Burnham and Book journey into extradimensional space in search of the next clue to the location of the Progenitors' power. Meanwhile, Rayner navigates his first mission in command of the USS Discovery, and Culber opens up to Tilly.

While undercover in a pre-warp society, Captain Burnham is forced to consider breaking the Prime Directive when a local tradition threatens Tilly's life. Meanwhile, Culber tries to connect with Stamets, and Adira steps up when Rayner assigns them a position on the bridge.

With Moll and L'ak in custody, the Federation is pulled into a diplomatic and ethical firestorm when the Breen demand they be handed over. Meanwhile, Booker looks for ways to help as Tilly, Adira, and Reno work to decipher the latest clue.

When Captain Burnham is trapped with a mindscape designed to test her worthiness to retrieve the Progenitors' powerful technology, Booker, Rayner, and the crew of the USS Discovery must hold off the Breen long enough for her to escape.
After Moll and the Breen capture a mysterious structure that contains the Progenitors' power, Captain Burnham must lead a covert mission to retrieve it before the Breen figure out how to use it.

Trapped inside a mysterious alien portal that defies familiar rules of time, space, and gravity, Captain Burnham must fight Moll – and the environment itself – in order to locate the Progenitors' technology and secure it for the Federation. Meanwhile, Booker puts himself in harm's way to help Burnham survive and Rayner leads the USS Discovery in an epic winner-takes-all battle against Breen forces.

After being on the run since age six, 21-year-old Caleb, a brilliant criminal hacker, is offered the chance of a lifetime: to join the first new Starfleet Academy class in San Francisco in over a century. There's just one problem – the person offering him the spot is newly-minted Chancellor Nahla Ake, the Starfleet captain who sentenced his mother to Federation prison fifteen years ago.

With the start of the new academic year, Caleb's unease about his future at Starfleet Academy persists. But when a delegation from a former Federation ally arrives and Caleb is tasked with showing their leader's daughter around campus, he must put his uncertainty aside to discover what life at the Academy is really about.

While the cadets compete to join an elite team at the Academy, a battle of escalating pranks breaks out between Starfleet Academy and a rival school. Tensions rise fast, threatening their newly-emerging bonds and a blossoming romance.

When an existential crisis threatens to wipe out a beloved but infamous species, a cadet is forced to confront his past and strained relationship with his family. As he pursues an unexpected method of coping, Nahla races against time to save this species from extinction.

As a cadet sets out to solve an ancient Starfleet mystery, she embarks on a journey of self-discovery and learns the value of forging her own path. Meanwhile, Nahla agrees to help a fellow chancellor with an elaborate alien ritual.

During the cadets' first training mission on an abandoned ship, they encounter a dangerous new enemy. As the cadets fight for survival, Ake must risk everything to save them by seeking help from an unexpected, untrustworthy, source.

As the cadets return home for their first school holiday, they must choose between what their families expect of them and their own dreams for the future – including an aspiring captain who's secretly willing to risk everything to re-write her own past, and an aristocratic cadet called to serve his planet way before he's ready.

A visiting instructor arrives at the Academy and uses an unorthodox method to help the cadets process the emotions of recent trauma. At the same time, a cadet faces an unexpected challenge that will alter the trajectory of her life forever.

As the year comes to an end, Caleb must choose between the life he thought he wanted and the life he's built for himself at Starfleet Academy. Meanwhile, Nahla breaks protocol in one final gambit to keep a promise to Caleb.

When an old enemy resurfaces as an existential threat to the Federation, Nahla must outwit a vengeful foe with a personal vendetta against her – as the cadets and instructors undertake a dangerous, seemingly impossible, mission to save everyone and everything they hold dear.
A Human soldier wakes up aboard the Discovery centuries after the ship has been abandoned, and develops a close relationship with the AI interface that saved him.

events.title: The universe is born
events.summary: The cosmos begins in a primordial expansion. Q later use the instant of creation as a hiding place, and Voyager is briefly carried there.
events.conflict: Voyager crew give two ages for the cosmos: 16 billion years ('Good Shepherd') and 20 billion years since the 'primordial atom burst' ('Latent Image'). Both run older than real-world cosmology's 13.8 billion.

events.title: Black Cluster forms
events.summary: Hundreds of protostars collapse close together, creating the gravitational hazard later called the Black Cluster, where the USS Vico is lost in 2368.

events.title: Guardian of Forever already waiting
events.tText: before Sol ignited (over 4.6 billion years ago)
events.summary: The time portal later found by Kirk's crew says it has awaited a question since before Earth's sun burned hot. The ruins around it are judged at least a million years old.
sources: The City on the Edge of Forever (episode)

events.title: Progenitors seed the galaxy
events.summary: Finding themselves alone in the galaxy, an ancient humanoid species seeds the primordial oceans of many worlds with a genetic program that steers life toward their own form. Discovery later learns they were themselves made by unknown creators whose technology they inherited.

events.title: Anti-time eruption at life's dawn
events.summary: Amino acids in Earth's primordial soup are about to form the first proteins. In Q's final test of humanity, a 24th-century anti-time anomaly grows backward through time and stops life on Earth from ever forming, until Picard, acting in three eras at once, collapses it.

events.title: Slaver Empire falls
events.summary: The Slavers rule most intelligent life in the galaxy until a revolt ends in a war that wipes out masters and subjects alike. Only their stasis boxes survive.

events.title: Insectoid ship scuttled at Questar M-17
events.summary: An alien vessel is taken over by a magnetic life-form, and its insectoid crew destroy their own ship rather than let the entity spread. The derelict still orbits Questar M-17 when the Enterprise finds it in 2269.

events.title: D'Arsay archive launched
events.summary: The D'Arsay civilization sends a comet-borne archive of its culture into space. It reaches the Enterprise-D in 2368 and briefly rewrites the ship and Data in its own image.

events.title: Martians and Dol'drm at war
events.summary: Prehistoric humanoid Martians fight an endless war with the arachnid Dol'drm of Sol's fifth planet. When Commander Cassell destroys the Dol'drm world, the planets' orbits shift and Mars slowly becomes uninhabitable.

events.title: Chicxulub impact ends the dinosaurs
events.summary: Cassell learns from the time-displaced Enterprise's records that Mars will die, and she destroys the Dol'drm homeworld with antimatter taken from the ship. A large fragment strikes Earth's Yucatán, the dinosaurs die out, and the way opens for humanity, in a causal loop the Enterprise of 2262 helped close.

events.title: Voth ancestors leave Earth
events.summary: Hadrosaurs that survived the extinction evolve intelligence, reach space and leave Earth. By about 20 million years ago their Voth descendants in the Delta Quadrant have begun the recorded history that later hides their origin.

events.title: Vexilon's builders ascend
events.summary: The makers of the planet-sized computer Vexilon ascend to the fifth dimension without updating its software, leaving it to run unattended for millions of years.

events.title: Tkon Empire falls
events.summary: A vast empire able to move whole stars ends when the central star of its home system goes supernova. Automated guardians such as Portal 63 outlast it.

events.title: Arretans colonize the galaxy
events.summary: Sargon's people of Arret are the galaxy's great spacefarers of their age and plant colonies widely. Sargon suggests Humans may descend from those colonists, and Spock notes that it could explain parts of Vulcan prehistory.

events.title: Arretan civilization destroys itself
events.summary: A final war strips Arret of its atmosphere. Sargon and a few others survive only as minds stored in receptacles deep underground.

events.title: Old Ones retreat beneath Exo III
events.summary: Exo III's sun begins to dim and the surface freezes. Its people move underground and build androids to serve them, and the machines eventually destroy their makers.
sources: What Are Little Girls Made Of? (episode)

events.title: Nuclear war drives Talosians underground
events.tText: hundreds of thousands of years before 2254
events.summary: A nuclear war nearly wipes out Talos IV's warp-capable civilization. The survivors retreat underground and let their technology decay while they develop their powers of illusion, the world Pike finds in 2254.

events.title: Admonition placed at the Eightfold Stars
events.summary: A synthetic civilization arranges eight stars around the planet Aia and leaves a warning there. Romulans who find it centuries later found the anti-synthetic Zhat Vash.

events.title: Iconia bombarded from orbit
events.summary: The gateway-building Iconians, remembered as 'Demons of Air and Darkness', are presumed wiped out when their homeworld is devastated from orbit. Their gateways still work in the 24th century.

events.title: Borg begin cybernetic evolution
events.summary: Guinan describes the Borg as organic and artificial life that has been developing for thousands of centuries. Their true origin is never given on screen.

events.title: Ancient relay network built
events.summary: Unknown builders construct a subspace relay network stretching across the Delta Quadrant. The Hirogen later claim it, and Voyager uses it to call home.

events.title: Horta's latest birth cycle begins
events.summary: On Janus VI, every Horta dies except one mother, who guards the eggs of the next generation. The cycle Kirk encounters began about fifty thousand years before 2267.

events.title: Bele begins hunting Lokai
events.summary: The Cheronian officer Bele sets out after the revolutionary Lokai. The chase lasts fifty thousand years, and by the time it ends on a dead Cheron their hatred has outlived their people.
sources: Let That Be Your Last Battlefield (episode)

events.title: Sky Spirits visit early Americans
events.summary: Delta Quadrant aliens visit a nomadic people of Earth, later the ancestors of Native Americans including Chakotay's tribe, and give them a genetic bond and lasting stories.

events.title: Verathan civilization at its height
events.summary: The Verathans of the Gamma Quadrant hold two dozen star systems. A Verathan statue is among the Gamma Quadrant relics Vash auctions on Deep Space 9 in 2369.

events.title: Oldest known Bajoran city built
events.summary: A walled Bajoran city rises around a stone tablet that imprisons a Prophet and a Pah-wraith. It is later buried, and B'hala is built on top of it.
events.conflict: Picard says the Bajorans were 'architects and artists, builders and philosophers when Humans were not yet standing erect' ('Ensign Ro'), which implies a civilization far older than any Bajoran site dated on screen.

events.title: Neanderthals disappear
events.summary: Phlox cites the extinction of Earth's Neanderthals as the kind of natural outcome he will not overrule, when he withholds a cure from the Valakians.

events.title: B'hala lost to history
events.summary: The holy city of B'hala disappears, and Bajorans search for it for ten thousand years without success. Sisko finds it in 2373 by following a 20,000-year-old painting.

events.title: Master of Tarquin Hill crafts a naiskos
events.summary: A Kurlan artisan makes a ceramic naiskos, a figure that holds many smaller figures and expresses the Kurlan belief that each person is a community of selves. Galen gives it to Picard in 2369, just before the Progenitor hunt.

events.title: Machine-god Vaal built
events.summary: A computer is built on Gamma Trianguli VI to tend its people's paradise. The Feeders of Vaal serve it unchanged for ten thousand years.

events.title: Fabrini launch the Yonada ark
events.summary: As their sun goes nova, the Fabrini place survivors inside a hollowed, steerable asteroid. After ten millennia in flight, its descendants have forgotten it is a ship.
sources: For the World is Hollow and I Have Touched the Sky (episode)

events.title: Sigma Draconis VI enters an ice age
events.summary: A civilization more advanced than the 23rd-century Federation meets a returning glacial age and declines, splitting into cave-dwelling Eymorg and surface Morg.

events.title: First Orb appears over Bajor
events.summary: The first Tear of the Prophets appears in Bajor's sky. Nine Orbs arrive over the next ten millennia, and the visions they grant shape Bajoran faith.

events.title: Rise of the Ferengi Alliance
events.summary: Nog says it took ten thousand years to build the Ferengi Alliance. Gint, the first Grand Nagus, writes the Rules of Acquisition, but his era is not dated on screen.

events.title: Humans taken to be raised by aliens
events.summary: Unknown aliens take a group of Humans from Earth and breed them to become guardians who will steer humanity through its dangerous age. Gary Seven is one of their descendants.

events.title: Akharin (Flint) born in Mesopotamia
events.summary: A Mesopotamian soldier finds he cannot die. Under many names, including Solomon, Leonardo and Brahms, he lives through six thousand years of Human history as Flint.

events.title: Landru builds his guardian computer
events.summary: The philosopher Landru ends a savage era on Beta III and builds a computer to keep the peace after his death. It rules his people by force of will until Kirk talks it into self-destruction in 2267.

events.title: Apollo's people visit ancient Greece
events.summary: A band of powerful aliens settles around the Mediterranean and is worshipped as the Greek gods. As belief fades they scatter, and Apollo is the last one left in 2267.

events.title: Sarpeidon's ice age receives exiles
events.summary: Sarpeidon's rulers send dissidents through the atavachron into the planet's past. Zarabeth lives out her exile in this ice age, where Spock and McCoy are briefly stranded in 2269.

events.title: Xindi-Avians build mountain fortress
events.summary: The Xindi-Avians build a concealed stronghold inside a mountain. After the Avians die out, it becomes the meeting chamber of the Xindi Council.

events.title: Sanctuary of P'Jem built
events.summary: Vulcans build the P'Jem monastery more than twelve centuries before the Time of Awakening, which shows interstellar reach long before Surak. The High Command later hides a listening post beneath it.

events.title: Trakor's prophecies of the Emissary
events.summary: After experiences with the Orb of Prophecy and Change, the Bajoran seer Trakor writes prophecies about the Emissary. Three thousand years later, Sisko sees them come true.

events.title: Lanthanites hidden among Humans
events.summary: Long-lived Lanthanites such as Pelia, born about five thousand years before the 23rd century, live secretly on Earth. Pelia claims to have known Pythagoras, and the species stays hidden until the 22nd century.
sources: The Sehlat Who Ate Its Tail (episode)

events.title: Kalandans wiped out by their own plague
events.tText: a few thousand years before 2268 (est. 1st millennium BCE)
events.summary: While building an artificial outpost world, the Kalandans accidentally create a lethal organism. Supply ships carry it home and the species apparently dies out, while the outpost's computer goes on guarding the planet.

events.title: Sahndaran refugees in classical Greece
events.summary: Survivors of the Sahndara supernova live on Earth in the age of Socrates and Plato. After Greek civilization fades they leave to found their Republic on Platonius.

events.title: Ba'ul turn the tables on Kelpiens
events.summary: On Kaminar, evolved Kelpiens nearly drive the Ba'ul extinct. The Ba'ul survive and impose a regime that culls Kelpiens before Vahar'ai, keeping them fearful prey for two thousand years.

events.title: Surak's Time of Awakening
events.summary: With Vulcan tearing itself apart with atomic weapons and psionic horrors like the Stone of Gol, Surak leads his people to logic and emotional control. It is the founding moment of modern Vulcan culture.

events.title: Surak dies; Kir'Shara hidden
events.summary: Surak dies of radiation sickness after the last battle against 'those who marched beneath the raptor's wings'. His katra is kept in an ark and his original writings, the Kir'Shara, are lost until 2154.

events.title: Debrune outpost on Barradas III
events.summary: The Debrune, an offshoot of the Romulan exodus, settle on Barradas III. Their ruins later draw Picard's archaeological eye and Baran's mercenaries.

events.title: Phage strikes the Vidiians
events.summary: A disease that eats away tissue and DNA begins ravaging the Vidiian Sodality. A people of explorers and artists become organ harvesters to survive.

events.title: Changelings found the Dominion
events.summary: Persecuted shape-shifters build an interstellar order in the Gamma Quadrant, run through the Vorta and enforced by the Jem'Hadar.
events.conflict: Weyoun 4 says the Dominion has endured two thousand years ('To the Death', 2372), while Weyoun 8 speaks of its founding 'ten thousand years ago' ('The Dogs of War', 2375).

events.title: Romulan exodus from Vulcan
events.summary: Vulcans who reject Surak's logic, having lost the war, leave their homeworld. They eventually settle the twin worlds of Romulus and Remus and become the Romulans.

events.title: Kahless unites the Klingon people
events.summary: Kahless the Unforgettable kills the tyrant Molor, defeats the Fek'Ihri, forges the first bat'leth and founds the Klingon Empire on a code of honor. Before he dies he promises to return.
events.conflict: 'Rightful Heir' has Boreth's clerics waiting fifteen centuries for his return (about 9th century), but 'Looking for par'Mach in All the Wrong Places' puts the stand at Qam-Chee, at the dawn of the Empire, 'a thousand years ago' (about 14th century).

events.title: Fifteen-century war begins on Solais V
events.summary: A war breaks out between the peoples of Solais V and lasts until both sides are nearly wiped out. They call in the mediator Riva in 2365.

events.title: Sphere-Builders seed the Delphic Expanse
events.summary: Beings from a transdimensional realm build a network of massive spheres whose gravimetric fields slowly reshape a region of space into the anomaly-choked Delphic Expanse. T'Pol dates one sphere to nearly a thousand years old.

events.title: Vissians develop warp drive
events.summary: The Vissians reach warp nearly a millennium before Earth. By Archer's time their ships far outclass Earth's.

events.title: Trill joining tradition on record
events.summary: The Trill custom of joining humanoid hosts with long-lived symbionts is already established. Trill authorities in 3189 cite two thousand years in which no joining with a non-Trill has succeeded.

events.title: Zetar destroyed
events.summary: All life on Zetar is wiped out. About a hundred minds survive as a storm of energy that searches for bodies to inhabit until it meets Mira Romaine.

events.title: Promellians and Menthars destroy each other
events.summary: A war near Orelious IX ends with the planet destroyed and both species wiped out. The Promellian cruiser Cleponji is caught in an aceton-assimilator trap that still works in 2366.

events.title: Kataan launches its memory probe
events.summary: As their sun heads toward nova, the people of Kataan send out a probe that holds a lifetime of their world. Picard lives that lifetime as Kamin.

events.title: Caretaker begins tending the Ocampa
events.summary: Nacene explorers accidentally ruin Ocampa's atmosphere and turn it to desert. One stays behind as the Caretaker, feeding the Ocampa underground for a thousand years.

events.title: Hur'q plunder Qo'noS
events.summary: Outsiders from the Gamma Quadrant raid the Klingon homeworld and carry off treasures, including the Sword of Kahless, which stays missing for a thousand years.

events.title: Hirogen take up the Hunt
events.summary: The Hirogen way of life, nomadic hunters stalking prey across the Delta Quadrant, takes the fixed form it will keep for a millennium.

events.title: Turei bombard the Vaadwaur homeworld
events.summary: The Vaadwaur's enemies end their subspace-corridor empire by making their homeworld uninhabitable. Six hundred soldiers go into stasis underground and wake 892 years later.

events.title: Borg control only a few systems
events.summary: According to the Vaadwaur survivor Gedrin, the Borg of his era are a minor Delta Quadrant power holding a handful of star systems.

events.title: T-Rogorans conquer the Skrreea
events.summary: The T-Rogorans kill the Skrreean leaders and force the survivors into servitude. The Skrreea are freed only when the Dominion conquers their masters.

events.title: Bajoran lightships reach Cardassia
events.summary: Bajorans sail solar-sail lightships beyond their system, and scholars claim one reached Cardassia. Sisko proves it possible in 2371, and the Cardassians grudgingly produce an ancient wreck.

events.title: Q jostles Newton's apple tree
events.summary: The renegade Q later called Quinn shakes the tree beneath Isaac Newton, so the falling apple that inspires his laws of motion is a Q's doing.

events.title: Megans driven from Salem
events.summary: Visitors from Megas-Tu, a dimension where magic works, are persecuted in the Salem witch trials and leave Earth. Their leader Lucien is remembered by Humans as Lucifer.

events.title: Eminiar VII and Vendikar go to war
events.summary: The two worlds begin a war that they eventually fight entirely by computer simulation. 'Casualties' report to disintegration chambers until Kirk ends the arrangement.

events.title: Preservers transplant Native Americans
events.summary: The Preservers, a mysterious race that rescues threatened cultures, move Navajo, Mohican and Delaware peoples to a distant world and leave an obelisk that deflects asteroids. The date is never given.

events.title: Onaya's muse claims John Keats
events.summary: An energy being that feeds on creative minds inspires the poet John Keats and hastens his early death. It later preys on Jake Sisko in 2373.

events.title: Suliban homeworld becomes uninhabitable
events.summary: The Suliban lose their world and become nomads. Two centuries later some of them join the Cabal's genetic bargain with a future faction.

events.title: Last Denobulan–Antaran war
events.summary: Denobula fights the last of its wars with the Antarans, killing twenty million of them. Phlox's family still carries the bitterness in the 2150s.

events.title: Vulcans return to the stars
events.summary: Soval says it took Vulcans nearly fifteen hundred years after Surak to rebuild their world and travel to the stars. That puts their return to interstellar flight around the mid-19th century.

events.title: Skagarans abduct Humans from the American West
events.summary: Alien slavers take Humans from 19th-century North America to a world in the Delphic Expanse. The captives revolt, and a frontier-town society survives there until Archer finds it in 2153.

events.title: Cardassian Union takes shape
events.summary: Cardassia's system of government is formed, with Central Command, the Obsidian Order and a nominally supreme Detapa Council. Dukat says it has stood for more than five centuries.

events.title: Redjac kills as Jack the Ripper
events.summary: A fear-eating energy being begins its killings in London. It reappears again and again across the centuries until Kirk traps it on Argelius II.

events.title: Devidians and Data in 1893 San Francisco
events.summary: Time-travelling Devidians feed on cholera victims in San Francisco. Data, Picard's away team, Guinan and Samuel Clemens stop them, and Data's head is left buried beneath the city until 2368.

events.title: Edith Keeler's death restores history
events.summary: McCoy leaps through the Guardian of Forever and saves the pacifist Edith Keeler, which delays America's entry into WWII and lets the Nazis win. Kirk lets her die and the timeline is restored.
sources: The City on the Edge of Forever (episode)

events.title: Xindi Civil War begins
events.summary: Xindus's six species go to war with each other. The fighting lasts about a century and ends with the planet destroyed.

events.title: Briori abduct Amelia Earhart
events.summary: The Briori take about three hundred Humans, including Amelia Earhart, to the Delta Quadrant as slave labor. Their descendants have built free cities by the time Voyager arrives.

events.title: Nazi-occupied America (altered 1944)
events.summary: After a Temporal Cold War incursion by Vosk's Na'kuhl faction, Lenin is assassinated before his revolution, and by 1944 Nazi Germany holds much of the eastern United States. Archer's crew destroys Vosk's time conduit and history is put back.

events.title: Ferengi crash at Roswell
events.summary: Quark, Rom, Nog and a stowaway Odo crash near Roswell after a warp malfunction throws their shuttle back from 2372. They escape, and the US Army calls it a weather balloon.

events.title: Vulcan–Andorian contact turns to feud
events.summary: The first meeting of Vulcans and Andorians seems promising, then turns into a border dispute that lasts two centuries, with Vulcan held back only by fear of Andorian retaliation.

events.title: Vulcans stranded at Carbon Creek
events.summary: A Vulcan survey ship sent to observe Sputnik crashes in Pennsylvania. Its crew, including T'Pol's ancestor T'Mir, lives quietly among Humans, and Mestral chooses to stay.
events.conflict: Quark boasts in 1947 that the Ferengi will have warp drive 'centuries before Humans or Klingons or even the Vulcans' ('Little Green Men'), yet Vulcans crew interstellar ships here in 1957 and had reached P'Jem by about 850 BCE.

events.title: Life-prolongation plague on Miri's world
events.summary: On a duplicate Earth, a life-extension virus kills every adult. The children who are left age one month per century until McCoy finds a cure.

events.title: Starling finds the timeship Aeon
events.summary: Captain Braxton's 29th-century timeship crashes in the High Sierras. Henry Starling strips its technology and uses it to drive the late-20th-century computer revolution.

events.title: Kelvan expedition leaves Andromeda
events.summary: Facing radiation that will make their galaxy uninhabitable within ten millennia, the Kelvans send a generation ship to scout the Milky Way. It arrives in 2268 and tries to take the Enterprise.

events.title: Gary Seven sabotages an orbital warhead
events.summary: Supervisor 194 arrives to stop a nuclear-armed orbital platform, and the Enterprise, back from 2268 to study the era, nearly foils him. The misfire he engineers pushes the powers toward new arms agreements.

events.title: Enterprise sighted over 1960s Earth
events.summary: Flung back by a black star, the Enterprise is spotted as a UFO and beams up USAF pilot John Christopher. Spock realizes Christopher's unborn son will lead an Earth–Saturn probe, so he must go home.

events.title: Apollo 11 lands on the Moon
events.summary: Humans first walk on another world. Kirk's crew hear the launch on 1969 radio, and Voyager's crew still honor the landing three centuries later.

events.title: NASA launches Voyager 6
events.summary: A NASA deep-space probe falls into a black hole and reaches a machine world, which rebuilds it into V'Ger and sends it home in search of its Creator.

events.title: Varro launch their generation ship
events.summary: The Varro build an enormous vessel to explore space. Over four centuries it becomes a closed, xenophobic world of its own.

events.title: Kirk's crew retrieves humpback whales
events.summary: To answer a probe that is devastating Earth in 2286, Kirk's crew goes back to San Francisco and takes two humpback whales, George and Gracie, along with cetologist Gillian Taylor. Scotty gives away the formula for transparent aluminum along the way.
sources: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home

events.title: Eugenics Wars
events.summary: Genetically engineered 'supermen' seize power. Khan Noonien Singh rules a quarter of the planet from Asia to the Middle East, and the wars kill tens of millions and lead to centuries of bans on genetic enhancement.
events.conflict: TOS dates the wars to 1992–1996 ('Space Seed'). DS9 twice puts them 'two hundred years ago' from 2373, in the 2170s ('Doctor Bashir, I Presume'). SNW shows Khan still a child in 2022 and places the wars between the Second Civil War and WWIII ('Tomorrow and Tomorrow and Tomorrow', 'Strange New Worlds'), blaming temporal interference on screen.

events.title: Khan flees Earth aboard the Botany Bay
events.summary: As the Eugenics Wars end, Khan and his followers escape in the DY-100 sleeper ship SS Botany Bay. The Enterprise finds it drifting in 2267.
sources: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
events.conflict: The 1990s launch follows TOS. In SNW's revised history Khan is still a boy in 2022, so a 1990s launch is impossible there and no replacement date is given on screen.

events.title: Voyager in 1996 Los Angeles
events.summary: Thrown back from 2373, Voyager stops Henry Starling from taking the Aeon into the future, which would have destroyed Earth's 29th century.

events.title: Nomad probe launched
events.summary: Jackson Roykirk's Nomad becomes Earth's first interstellar probe. It is damaged by a meteoroid, merges with an alien probe and returns in 2267 as a sterilizing machine.

events.title: Xindi bioweapon averted in Detroit
events.summary: Xindi-Reptilians from 2153 hide in Detroit to brew a bioweapon from Human blood. Archer and T'Pol, sent by the temporal agent Daniels, stop them.

events.title: Millennium Gate completed
events.summary: The kilometer-high, self-sustaining Millennium Gate in Indiana, started on January 1, 2001, is finished. It later serves as the model for the first Mars colony.

events.title: First crewed mission to Saturn
events.summary: Colonel Shaun Geoffrey Christopher commands the first successful Earth–Saturn mission, which is why the Enterprise had to return his father to 1969.

events.title: Sleeper ships made obsolete
events.summary: Advances in sublight propulsion end the era of cryogenic sleeper ships like the Botany Bay.

events.title: Sanctuary Districts established
events.summary: Every major American city walls off districts for the homeless and unemployed. The districts decay into internment camps.
events.conflict: DS9's districts are walled, guarded camps. The one Picard's crew walks through in 2024 Los Angeles has no walls or checkpoints and appears only on a regulations poster ('Assimilation').

events.title: La'an saves young Khan in Toronto
events.summary: Stranded in 2022, La'an Noonien-Singh and an alternate James Kirk stop the Romulan agent Sera from assassinating Khan as a child, which preserves the path to the Federation.

events.title: Ireland reunified
events.summary: Data cites Ireland's reunification after a century of violence as a case where terrorism achieved its goal.

events.title: Picard's crew in 2024 Los Angeles
events.summary: Sent back by Q to repair a timeline that became the Confederation of Earth, Picard's crew clashes with a Borg Queen joined with Agnes Jurati and with geneticist Adam Soong. Rios stays behind.

events.title: Europa Mission launches
events.summary: Renée Picard's Shango crew launches for Jupiter's moon Europa after the time-travelling Supervisor Tallinn gives her life to protect her. The mission finds a lifeform that later helps restore Earth's environment.

events.title: Gabriel Bell dies; Sisko takes his name
events.summary: Newly arrived from 2371, Sisko and Bashir see the real Gabriel Bell stabbed to death protecting them. Sisko takes on Bell's identity so that history goes the way it was recorded, and the record later shows Bell dying in the September 3 raid, with Sisko's face.

events.title: Bell Riots
events.summary: Residents of San Francisco's Sanctuary District A take hostages and tell the world their stories before the National Guard storms the district. The outrage pushes America to face its social crisis, a step on the road to the Federation.

events.title: World War III begins
events.summary: Civil unrest in the United States grows into a Second Civil War and then into global war. Colonel Phillip Green's faction alone kills some 37 million people.
sources: In A Mirror, Darkly, Part II (episode)
events.conflict: SNW describes one escalation from the Second Civil War through the Eugenics Wars into WWIII, while TOS put the Eugenics Wars three decades earlier. The c. 2026 start comes from a Starfleet archive display, not dialogue.

events.title: Ares IV mission and John Kelly's loss
events.summary: An early crewed mission to Mars lands its surface team, but the command module and Lieutenant John Kelly are swallowed by a graviton ellipse. Voyager recovers the module in 2374.

events.title: Xindus destroyed; Xindi diaspora
events.summary: Reptilians and Insectoids set off charges in the homeworld's great seismic fissures and end the century-long civil war. The Avians die out, and the survivors scatter under the guidance of the Sphere-Builders, whom they call 'the Guardians'.

events.title: New United Nations rules against inherited guilt
events.summary: The New United Nations declares that no citizen of Earth may be made to answer for the crimes of their race or ancestors. Picard cites the ruling at Q's trial.

events.title: Alternate Enterprise stranded in 2037
events.summary: A subspace corridor throws an Enterprise 117 years into the past, into the Delphic Expanse. Its crew's descendants, led by Lorian, spend generations preparing to change the Xindi war.

events.title: Charybdis launched beyond the Sol system
events.summary: Colonel Stephen Richey commands Earth's third crewed attempt to leave the solar system. Aliens who accidentally destroy the ship build him a casino modeled on a pulp novel, where he lives until 2082.

events.title: Baseball's last World Series
events.summary: Only three hundred spectators watch Buck Bokai's London Kings win what proves to be the last World Series, as the game fades from popularity.

events.title: Hermosa Quake sinks Los Angeles
events.summary: A great earthquake drowns parts of Los Angeles under two hundred meters of water.

events.title: Humpback whales hunted to extinction
events.summary: Whaling kills off the humpback, so an alien probe that calls for them in 2286 gets no answer, until Kirk brings back George and Gracie.
sources: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home

events.title: Andorians settle Weytahn
events.summary: Andorian colonists begin terraforming the class D world they call Weytahn. The Vulcans, who call it Paan Mokar, soon dispute the claim.

events.title: Nuclear finale of World War III
events.summary: Nuclear strikes devastate cities and most major governments collapse before a ceasefire ends the war. About six hundred million people are dead.

events.title: Red Angel rescues a church congregation
events.summary: As bombs fall near Richmond, Indiana, the time-travelling Gabrielle Burnham takes a church congregation to the distant world Terralysium, where they found New Eden.

events.title: Borg try to stop First Contact
events.summary: A Borg sphere from 2373 attacks Cochrane's Montana base to prevent first contact and assimilate Earth. The Enterprise-E destroys it and fights off drones on board, and debris from the sphere lies in the Arctic until 2153.

events.title: First Contact with Vulcans
events.summary: Zefram Cochrane's Phoenix makes Earth's first warp flight from Bozeman, Montana. A passing Vulcan ship, the T'Plana-Hath, detects the warp signature and lands that evening, beginning Earth's place among the stars.

events.title: Vulcans take up residence on Earth
events.summary: In the decades after first contact, Vulcans keep a diplomatic presence on Earth, later a compound in Sausalito, and advise humanity's recovery. Many Humans come to resent how firmly they hold back Earth's reach into space.

events.title: SS Valiant lost at the galactic barrier
events.summary: An early Earth starship is swept to the edge of the galaxy by a magnetic storm. After crew members develop dangerous psychic powers, its captain destroys the ship.
sources: Where No Man Has Gone Before (episode)

events.title: Ba'ku renounce technology and leave
events.summary: About five hundred pacifist Brek'a leave a world on the brink of self-destruction and settle a planet whose rings slow aging. They give up advanced technology.

events.title: Friendship 1 launched
events.summary: The United Earth Space Probe Agency, the earliest 'United Earth' body in the timeline, sends a probe with greetings and technical data for any species it meets. Starfleet loses contact with it in 2248.

events.title: Great Awakening on Argelius II
events.summary: Argelians abandon violence for a society of pleasure. They become so peaceful that they have to hire off-worlders to run their government.

events.title: Terra 10 colonists leave Earth
events.summary: Colonists bound for Terra 10 in the Cepheus system depart while Earth ships still use the old intersat code. Radiation shrinks their descendants, the Terratins, to miniature size and the colony is forgotten until 2269.

events.title: Last Klingon emperor dies
events.summary: The Klingon throne falls vacant with no one to claim it, and the High Council takes real power. The office is revived in 2369 for the clone of Kahless.

events.title: Kzinti Wars end in Human victory
events.summary: Humans win the last of four wars with the feline Kzinti, who are left with nothing but police vessels.
events.conflict: Sulu dates the last war to about 2069, only six years after Cochrane's first warp flight. First Contact shows Humans alone in 2063, and Friendship One is launched in 2067 with humanity having 'no idea' what threats lie beyond.

events.title: Nakan massacre on Tarakis
events.summary: Soldiers under Commander Saavdra kill 82 Nakan civilians on Tarakis. A memorial later implants the massacre in the memories of visitors, including Voyager's crew.

events.title: Terra Nova colony founded
events.summary: The SS Conestoga, launched in 2069 and flying just above warp 1, reaches Terra Nova and becomes Earth's first extrasolar colony.

events.title: Post-atomic horror
events.summary: In the war's aftermath, drug-controlled soldiers and kangaroo courts rule, and the idea of a 'United Earth' is swept aside. Q later judges humanity in a replica of one of these courts.

events.title: Terra Nova silenced by asteroid strike
events.summary: A radioactive asteroid impact drives Terra Nova's survivors underground and cuts them off from Earth. Their descendants come to blame Earth for the disaster, until Enterprise finds them in 2151.

events.title: Treaty of 2097 gives Weytahn to Vulcan
events.summary: When Andorian settlers refuse inspection, the Vulcans annex Weytahn as Paan Mokar under the Treaty of 2097. The dispute flares repeatedly until Archer brokers a ceasefire in 2152.

events.title: Boomer freighter Horizon commissioned
events.summary: The J-class freighter Horizon joins the Earth Cargo Service. Families of 'boomers' spend their lives on these slow ships, and Travis Mayweather is born aboard in 2126.

events.title: First Mars colony established
events.summary: Humanity's first colony on Mars is founded, modeled on the Millennium Gate. Picard's ancestors are among the pioneers.
events.conflict: Voyager dates the first Martian colony to 2103, but 'Terra Nova' has Utopia Planitia on Mars and New Berlin on the Moon already settled by 2069.

events.title: Andorians find the Aenar
events.summary: The blind, telepathic, pacifist Aenar of Andoria's northern wastes, long thought a myth, are found by the Andorians.

events.title: Redjac strikes the Martian colonies
events.summary: The Jack the Ripper entity kills eight women in the young Martian colonies on its long run from world to world.

events.title: European Hegemony forms
events.summary: A loose European alliance forms, one of the first steps toward a single world government. By 2123 it has its own starship distress beacon, which colony ships like the Mariposa carry.

events.title: Jonathan Archer born
events.summary: The future captain of Enterprise NX-01, and later Federation President, is born in upstate New York, son of the warp engineer Henry Archer.

events.title: War, poverty and disease ended on Earth
events.summary: As the time travelers of 2063 predict, within about fifty years of first contact humanity ends war, poverty and disease on Earth.

events.title: Zefram Cochrane vanishes
events.summary: At 87, the father of warp drive leaves the Alpha Centauri colony on a final voyage and is never seen again. In 2267 Kirk finds him on a planetoid near Gamma Canaris, kept young by a companion being.
sources: In A Mirror, Darkly, Part II (episode)
events.conflict: 'Metamorphosis' (87 years old, missing 150 years by 2267) and an archive file put the disappearance in 2117, yet 'Broken Bow' shows Cochrane dedicating the Warp Five Complex in 2119.

events.title: Warp Five Complex opened
events.summary: Cochrane dedicates the Warp Five Complex in Bozeman, where Henry Archer leads the effort to build an engine fast enough for true exploration. Cochrane's speech introduces the words 'where no man has gone before'.

events.title: SS Mariposa colony ship launched
events.summary: A DY-500 ship leaves Baikonur for the Ficus sector. Its colonists split into the cloning Mariposans and the Neo-Transcendentalist Bringloidi.

events.title: Henry Archer dies
events.summary: The designer of the warp five engine dies of Clarke's disease, years before his engine flies. His son Jonathan will command the ship built around it.

events.title: Emory Erickson invents the transporter
events.summary: Emory Erickson builds Earth's molecular transporter and is the first person to use it. By 2128 children read about the 'Father of the Transporter'.

events.title: Klingon ship returns from the Expanse
events.summary: A Klingon vessel emerges from the Delphic Expanse with its crew anatomically turned inside out yet alive, which feeds the region's deadly reputation.

events.title: Arik Soong steals Augment embryos
events.summary: Geneticist Arik Soong takes Eugenics-era embryos from Cold Station 12 and raises them in hiding on Trialas IV until he is captured in 2144. The Augments return to haunt Earth in 2154.

events.title: Syrran receives Surak's katra
events.summary: The Vulcan Syrran finds a katric ark holding Surak's living mind and takes it into himself. With it he founds the Syrrannites, who seek Surak's true teachings.

events.title: Erickson's teleporter traps his son
events.summary: Erickson's experimental sub-quantum teleporter fails and leaves volunteers, including his son Quinn, lost in subspace. He tries to bring Quinn back for years.

events.title: NX-Alpha breaks the warp 2 barrier
events.summary: A.G. Robinson flies NX-Alpha past warp 2 before it breaks apart. Days later Archer and Robinson take NX-Beta past warp 2 in an unauthorized flight that saves the NX program.

events.title: V'tosh ka'tur leave Vulcan
events.summary: Vulcans who want to explore emotion instead of suppressing it leave their homeworld aboard the Vahklas, a small counterculture in the logic-bound society.

events.title: Tandarans intern the Suliban
events.summary: After Cabal attacks, the Tandarans round up all Suliban, innocent or not, into detention complexes.

events.title: Warp 3 reached by NX-Delta
events.summary: Duvall becomes the first Human to break warp 3, flying the NX-Delta testbed. Earth is now closing in on a warp five starship.

events.title: Borg learn of the Omega molecule
events.summary: By assimilating Species 262, the Borg hear legends of Omega, a molecule of perfect power. They begin a centuries-long hunt for it.

events.title: Earth fully unified
events.summary: The last holdout nations join the World Government, completing a unification begun by the European Hegemony. United Earth now speaks for all of humanity.

events.title: Keel of Enterprise NX-01 laid
events.summary: Construction begins on Earth's first warp five starship, and Admiral Forrest picks Jonathan Archer over A.G. Robinson to command it. The ship launches in April 2151.

incursions.title: Cold-start jump back seventy-one hours
incursions.summary: An emergency cold restart of the engines to escape a collapsing planet's orbit throws the Enterprise back 71 hours. Spock notes the method could be used for deliberate time travel.

incursions.title: Enterprise hurled back to 1969

legs.note: slingshot back to the moment before the jet encounter, to return Captain Christopher and the air police sergeant

incursions.method: black star gravity well; return by slingshot effect
incursions.summary: A black star's pull flings the Enterprise into 1969 Earth orbit, where it is spotted by the US Air Force. Spock times a slingshot around the Sun to drop the captured airmen back before their encounter and carry the ship home.

incursions.title: McCoy through the Guardian

legs.note: a delirious McCoy saves Edith Keeler, erasing the Federation
Kirk and Spock follow to undo the change

incursions.summary: An accidental cordrazine overdose sends McCoy leaping through the Guardian into Depression-era New York, where saving a pacifist's life lets Germany win the Second World War. Kirk and Spock follow and must let her die to restore history.
sources: The City on the Edge of Forever (episode)

incursions.title: Historical research voyage to 1968
incursions.summary: The Enterprise travels to 1968 on an authorized historical survey and collides with Gary Seven's covert mission to sabotage an orbital weapons launch. The records they check afterward show events went exactly as they witnessed.

incursions.title: Landing party lost in Sarpeidon's past

to.tText: Sarpeidon's past: an era like Earth's 17th century (year unstated)

legs.note: placeholder t; the episode gives no year

incursions.summary: Hours before Beta Niobe goes nova, Kirk stumbles through the library's time portal into a witch-hunting past while Spock and McCoy land in an ice age 5,000 years back. All three return through the portal moments before the star explodes.
incursions.conflict: Kirk's destination year is never given; t=1700 is a placeholder. MA files TOS S3 in 2269; the TAS lane is used for the return because the episode sits at the TOS/TAS seam.

incursions.title: Sarpeidon's population flees into history

legs.note: placeholder t for the whole population's dispersal into chosen eras
Mr. Atoz follows his family last, just before the nova

incursions.summary: Warned of their sun's imminent nova, Sarpeidon's entire population prepared their bodies with the atavachron and escaped into eras of their own past. The librarian Atoz is the last to go; Zarabeth was exiled to the ice age earlier by the same device.
incursions.conflict: No dates are given for any of the exodus eras; t is a placeholder.

incursions.title: Spock saves his own childhood

legs.note: historical survey; placeholder t
they return to a timeline in which Spock died as a child
Spock poses as his cousin Selek to guide his younger self through the kahs-wan

incursions.summary: Returning from a survey of Orion history, Spock finds a timeline in which he died at age seven. He goes back to Vulcan as 'cousin Selek' to ensure his younger self survives, at the cost of his pet sehlat I-Chaya.
incursions.conflict: The Orion-history destination is undated; t=-5000 is a placeholder.

incursions.title: Bounty sails back for humpbacks
incursions.summary: To answer a whale-song probe devastating Earth, Kirk's fugitive crew slingshots a captured Klingon Bird-of-Prey to 1986 and brings back two humpback whales plus the cetologist Gillian Taylor, who stays in the 23rd century.
sources: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home

incursions.title: Tholian Web Defiant lands a century early

legs.note: the ship crossed both universes and about a century

incursions.summary: The USS Defiant, lost to interphase in Tholian space, emerged roughly a century in the past and in the mirror universe, where the Tholians lured it and Terran Empire officers captured it in 2155.
sources: In A Mirror, Darkly, Part II (episode)
incursions.conflict: Arrival date inferred from its discovery in January 2155; the exact emergence time is unstated.

incursions.title: Manheim experiment repeats a moment

legs.note: loop: a few seconds replay for the Enterprise-D, the USS Lalo and the Coltar IV colony

incursions.summary: Dr. Paul Manheim's dimensional experiment on Vandor IV causes brief time skips in which a moment replays. Data seals the rift with antimatter to end the effect.

incursions.title: Picard's six-hours-future double
incursions.summary: A shuttlepod carrying a dazed Picard from six hours in the future is recovered just before an energy vortex destroys the Enterprise in his timeline. The present Picard breaks the cycle by steering the ship into the vortex's center.

incursions.title: Enterprise-C through the Narendra rift

legs.note: its absence from the battle rewrites history into a Klingon war
returns to die at Narendra III, carrying the alternate Tasha Yar

incursions.summary: The Enterprise-C falls through a temporal rift 22 years forward, creating a timeline of Federation-Klingon war. Its crew goes back to certain death to restore history, and the alternate Tasha Yar joins them. Her fate in 2344 later produces Sela.

incursions.title: Vorgons pursue the Tox Uthat

legs.note: they leave empty-handed

incursions.summary: Two 27th-century Vorgon criminals travel to Risa to seize the Tox Uthat, a weapon able to halt a star's fusion. Picard destroys it and they return to their own time empty-handed.

incursions.title: Kal Dano hides his invention
incursions.summary: The Tox Uthat's inventor fled his own century and hid the device on 22nd-century Risa to keep it from criminals. It stayed hidden until 2366.
incursions.conflict: Described, not shown; exact years unstated.

incursions.title: Rasmussen's stolen time-pod

legs.note: the pod's rightful owner, a historian, visits the 22nd century
Rasmussen steals the pod and poses as a 26th-century historian
the pod returns empty on its preset program

incursions.summary: A 22nd-century inventor steals a visiting historian's time-pod and arrives aboard the Enterprise-D posing as a 26th-century researcher, collecting gadgets to 'invent' back home. Picard sends the pod back empty and Rasmussen is stranded in 2368.
incursions.conflict: Rasmussen's exact home year in the 22nd century is not stated.

incursions.title: Enterprise-D caught in causality loop

legs.note: loop: the ship relives the same ~17 days until Data plants a clue
the USS Bozeman emerges 90 years after it entered the distortion

incursions.summary: A collision with the emerging USS Bozeman destroys the Enterprise-D over and over as a temporal distortion resets time. Data's buried subconscious message breaks the loop, and the Bozeman learns it has been lost for 90 years.

incursions.title: Devidians feed on 1893 San Francisco

legs.note: repeated trips; the Devidians harvest neural energy from the dying

incursions.summary: Phase-shifted aliens from Devidia II use a time portal to prey on cholera victims in 1893 San Francisco. The Enterprise-D destroys the portal to end the harvest.

incursions.title: Data's head in a Frisco cavern

legs.note: Data follows the Devidians
Picard, Riker, Troi, Crusher and La Forge follow to retrieve him
away team and a stowaway Samuel Clemens return; Picard stays behind
Clemens goes home
Picard returns last

incursions.summary: Data's 500-year-old head is dug up in San Francisco, and he duly travels back to 1893, where he is decapitated and his head is buried. His crewmates follow, meet the young Guinan, and bring back a curious Samuel Clemens, who returns home soon after.

incursions.title: Q replays Picard's reckless youth

legs.note: Picard's consciousness in his younger body, days before the Nausicaan fight
without the stabbing, he returns as an unremarkable junior lieutenant
he asks to go back and provokes the fight after all

incursions.summary: As Picard lies near death, Q lets him relive the day he was stabbed through the heart. Avoiding the fight produces a timid career as a lieutenant, so Picard chooses to take the blade again.
incursions.conflict: Q leaves it open whether any of this was real or a near-death experience.

incursions.title: Time runs backward at a warp breach

legs.note: local time reversal around the Enterprise and a Romulan warbird

incursions.method: temporal fragments around a Romulan artificial quantum singularity
incursions.summary: Returning by runabout, Picard's team finds the Enterprise frozen mid-way through a warp core breach, part of a zone of broken time created by alien life nesting in a Romulan singularity. Time runs backward to before the breach, and Picard severs the power beam behind it.

incursions.title: K'mtar comes back as Alexander

legs.note: presumed return

incursions.summary: An adult Alexander, whose father was murdered in his timeline, comes back under the name K'mtar to push his younger self toward the warrior path. Worf accepts his son as he is, leaving the future open.

incursions.title: Picard shifts across three eras

legs.note: repeated shifts among the three eras
Q shows Picard the moment life fails to form

incursions.summary: Q's final test sends Picard's consciousness among 2364, 2370 and a possible 2395, where anti-time spreading from the Devron system threatens to stop life from ever beginning on Earth. Three Enterprises collapse the anomaly together.

incursions.title: Two captains leave the Nexus

legs.note: Kirk is swept into the Nexus in 2293 and chooses to leave it in 2371
Picard exits the Nexus just before the Veridian star is destroyed

incursions.summary: Inside the timeless Nexus, Picard recruits a Kirk lost there since 2293, and both leave at a moment of their choosing, before Soran destroys the Veridian star. They stop the launch; Kirk dies on Veridian III.

incursions.title: Borg sphere strikes first contact

legs.note: Earth's history becomes an assimilated timeline in 2373

incursions.summary: Beaten at Sector 001, a Borg sphere opens a temporal vortex to the day before Zefram Cochrane's warp flight, to assimilate a defenseless Earth. The present instantly becomes a Borg world.

incursions.title: Enterprise-E follows to 2063

legs.note: shielded in the vortex's wake, the ship follows

incursions.summary: Protected by the vortex's wake, the Enterprise-E follows the Borg back, destroys the sphere, repels a Borg takeover of the ship, and ensures Cochrane's flight and the Vulcan landing happen on schedule.
incursions.conflict: Maj'el later cites the Cochrane flight as a predestination paradox involving Starfleet (PRO 'Who Saves the Saviors').

incursions.title: Sisko becomes Gabriel Bell

legs.note: Bell's death erases Starfleet above them in 2371

incursions.method: transporter malfunction (chroniton particles in the Defiant's cloak)
incursions.summary: A chroniton-tainted transport strands three officers in 2024 San Francisco, where Gabriel Bell is killed before the riots that bear his name. Sisko takes Bell's place and his photograph ends up in the history files.

incursions.title: Kira and O'Brien sweep the decades

legs.note: returns with the stranded officers

incursions.summary: The Defiant's chroniton-charged transporter gives Kira and O'Brien only ten tries to find their lost crewmates. They beam down to 1930, 1967 and 2048 before finding the right year.

incursions.title: O'Brien glimpses DS9's destruction

legs.note: sees the station destroyed by the Romulans
a future O'Brien replaces his dead present self

incursions.method: temporal displacement (radiation exposure plus a cloaked warbird's singularity)
incursions.summary: Radiation exposure near a cloaked Romulan warbird's singularity makes O'Brien skip hours into the future, where he sees himself die and the station explode. The O'Brien who remains is the one from a few hours later, who uses what he saw to prevent the attack.

incursions.title: Sisko anchored to Jake's future

legs.note: Jake's death breaks the link and Sisko snaps back to the accident

incursions.summary: Thrown out of time in an engineering accident, Sisko reappears at intervals of years, tethered to his son. An aged Jake ends his own life to cut the tether, returning his father to the moment of the accident.

incursions.title: Ferengi crash at Roswell

legs.note: kemocite reaction with an atomic test blast

incursions.method: warp field time warp (sabotaged warp core, kemocite)
incursions.summary: Sabotage flings Quark's shuttle from its trip to Earth into 1947, making its passengers the aliens of the Roswell incident. They escape by pairing their kemocite with a nuclear test blast.

incursions.title: Prophets send Akorem Laan forward

legs.note: returned to finish his poem

incursions.summary: A legendary Bajoran poet lost two centuries earlier emerges from the wormhole claiming to be the Emissary. Sisko asks the Prophets to send him home, where he completes the poem that history already knew.

incursions.title: Defiant to Space Station K-7

legs.note: carried by the Orb of Time

incursions.summary: A surgically altered Arne Darvin uses the Orb of Time to go back and plant a tribble bomb meant to kill Kirk. The Defiant's crew trails him through the original Enterprise's tribble crisis and removes the bomb.

incursions.title: Defiant's descendants on Gaia

legs.note: in the original loop the Defiant crashes and its crew founds Gaia

incursions.summary: A barrier planet's energy would throw the Defiant 200 years back, where its stranded crew would found a colony of 8,000 descendants. An elder Odo alters the escape course, the ship gets through safely, and Gaia never exists.

incursions.title: Kira visits her mother's Terok Nor
incursions.summary: Kira uses the Orb of Time to see whether Dukat's claims about her mother, Meru, are true. She finds them true, nearly assassinates both, and relents.
sources: Wrongs Darker Than Death or Night (episode)

incursions.title: Molly O'Brien lost three centuries

legs.note: a feral 18-year-old Molly is retrieved
her parents send her back, arriving just after her younger self
older Molly sends young Molly home and vanishes

incursions.summary: Eight-year-old Molly falls through an ancient time portal and is recovered as a feral adult. Sent back through, the older Molly pushes her younger self home and erases her own life.

incursions.title: Cusak's distress call three years displaced

legs.note: time-displaced communication, not travel
the Defiant's replies reach her own time

incursions.summary: The Defiant's crew talks for days with a stranded captain, not realizing that their signals are crossing three years. They arrive to find she died long ago.

incursions.title: Voyager caught in a singularity's echo

legs.note: event-horizon time distortion produces a duplicate Voyager image

incursions.method: event horizon of a quantum singularity
incursions.summary: Trapped behind a quantum singularity's event horizon, Voyager chases a mirror image of itself that is really a time-shifted reflection. Janeway and Torres find the real exit.
incursions.conflict: Memory Alpha lists this as a short backward jump; on screen it plays as time and space distortion rather than clear travel.

incursions.title: Janeway and Paris on doomsday's eve

legs.note: their rescue attempt caused the explosion; closing the fracture erases the whole episode

incursions.summary: Subspace fractures carry Janeway and Paris to the day before a polaric explosion destroys a planet. It emerges that Voyager's own rescue caused the blast, and collapsing the fracture resets events so it never happens.

incursions.title: Micro-wormhole to a 2351 Romulan

legs.note: test cylinder
Telek R'Mor beamed aboard Voyager
R'Mor returned to his own time with the crew's messages

incursions.summary: A micro-wormhole to the Alpha Quadrant links Voyager with a Romulan scientist who turns out to live 20 years in the past. He agrees to deliver the crew's letters in 2371, but dies in 2367 before he can.

incursions.title: Quinn hides Voyager at the Big Bang

legs.note: Quinn hides Voyager at the beginning of the universe
Q pursues

incursions.summary: The Q prisoner Quinn, seeking asylum, hides Voyager at the Big Bang during a chase with Q. The pursuit ends with an asylum hearing aboard ship.
incursions.conflict: The universe's age is never stated on screen; t=-1.38e10 uses the real-world estimate.

incursions.title: Braxton's Aeon attacks Voyager

legs.note: Braxton tries to destroy Voyager, blaming it for a future explosion
the Aeon crashes on Earth; Henry Starling finds it and Braxton lives as a vagrant for 30 years

incursions.summary: A 29th-century timeship attacks Voyager to prevent a disaster Braxton blames on it. Both ships fall into the rift, the Aeon crashes in 1967, and Henry Starling builds his computer empire from its technology.

incursions.title: Voyager stranded in 1996 Los Angeles

legs.note: a Braxton from the repaired timeline comes to collect Voyager
returned to the Delta Quadrant, not the Alpha

incursions.summary: Voyager arrives in 1996 and must stop Starling from flying the stolen timeship to the future, where it would cause the explosion Braxton feared. Once history is fixed, an unaware Braxton returns them to 2373 in the Delta Quadrant.

incursions.title: Kes lives her life backward

legs.note: year unstated; estimated
before she joined Voyager
the Doctor's chroniton-free chamber pulls her back

incursions.method: chroniton radiation reactivated by a bio-temporal chamber
incursions.summary: In a future where she married Tom Paris, a dying Kes starts jumping backward through her own life, a delayed effect of Krenim chroniton radiation. Knowledge from the jumps lets the Doctor stabilize her, and she wakes in 2373 knowing what will happen.
incursions.conflict: Several jumps are dated only relatively on screen; those legs use estimated t values (see leg notes).

incursions.title: Krenim weapon ship erases itself

to.tText: the 2170s (before the weapon ship was built)

legs.note: the ship's destruction unmakes two centuries of its temporal incursions; Voyager resets to March 16, 2374

incursions.summary: For two centuries Annorax's weapon ship erased whole species from history to rebuild the Krenim Imperium and bring back his wife. When Voyager rams it, the ship erases itself: the incursions never happened, and Voyager's year of hell never begins.

incursions.title: Kim rewrites Voyager's fatal crash

legs.note: corrected slipstream phase variance and a message sent via Borg temporal transmitter, not travel

incursions.summary: Fifteen years after a slipstream accident killed everyone aboard Voyager, Kim and Chakotay steal the Delta Flyer and send corrective data back to Seven of Nine. The ship survives, and their future is erased.

incursions.title: Seven hunts a saboteur through time

legs.note: Seven is recruited at the moment Voyager explodes
Seven searches for the planted device
an older, deranged Braxton
a different Seven and Janeway taken aboard the Relativity
Janeway pursues the saboteur
Janeway returns with the arrested Braxton
Janeway and Seven sent home before the explosion

incursions.summary: The 29th-century timeship Relativity recruits Seven to find who planted a temporal disruptor aboard Voyager. The culprit is a future Braxton taking revenge on Janeway, and three versions of Braxton are involved before the device is removed.

incursions.title: Aged Kes returns for her youth

legs.note: an older, embittered Kes sabotages Voyager for the Vidiians
implied: she is next seen in 2376, being sent home to Ocampa

incursions.method: psychokinetic power boosted by Voyager's warp core
incursions.summary: An older, embittered Kes uses Voyager's warp core to go back to 2371 and take her younger self home. A holo-message recorded by the young Kes warns Janeway in time and later reminds the older Kes who she was.

incursions.title: Voyager splintered into temporal fragments

legs.note: Kim, Torres and Ayala cross fragments
Seven of Nine crosses fragments
adult Icheb and Naomi Wildman from a 2394 fragment

incursions.method: temporal rift (ship fractured into time zones)
incursions.summary: A temporal rift splits Voyager into fragments from different years. Chakotay, the only one inoculated against the shift, crosses them with a 2371 Janeway to set a chroniton torpedo, while Seska and the Kazon hold one section.

incursions.title: Admiral Janeway brings Voyager home early

legs.note: she dies in the Borg Queen's unicomplex

incursions.summary: In a 2404 where Voyager took 23 years to get home, Admiral Janeway buys a chrono deflector and returns to 2378 with future armor and weapons. She gets Voyager home through a Borg transwarp hub and cripples the Collective.

incursions.title: Q junior traps Voyager in a loop

legs.note: loop: the same 30 seconds repeat

incursions.summary: Q's delinquent son amuses himself by trapping Voyager's crew in a 30-second causality loop, one of the pranks that lead his father to strip his powers for a probation.

incursions.title: Future Guy briefs the Cabal

legs.note: orders the Paraagan II frame-up
tells Archer the Xindi are behind the attack on Earth
orders Silik to stow away for 1944

incursions.method: partial materialization through a Suliban temporal chamber (communication only)
incursions.summary: The unseen benefactor of the Suliban Cabal speaks from the 28th century through a temporal chamber, sending orders and technology. He cannot travel physically, and his identity is never revealed.
incursions.conflict: The 28th-century origin rests on Archer's line in 'Storm Front, Part II'.

incursions.title: Daniels embedded aboard NX-01

legs.note: posing as a steward from launch
