incursions.summary: A 31st-century temporal agent serves as a crewman aboard Earth's first warp-five ship to watch the Temporal Cold War. He reveals himself to Archer when the Suliban come for his temporal observatory.

incursions.title: Time tourists watch the pyramids rise

legs.note: shown to Archer as an example of sanctioned observation

incursions.summary: Daniels tells Archer that time-traveling anthropologists from 2769 watched the Great Pyramids being built. He offers it as an example of sanctioned travel under the Temporal Accords.
incursions.conflict: The pyramid-building date (c. 2560 BCE) is real-world history, not stated in dialogue.

incursions.title: Daniels hides Archer in the 31st century

legs.note: a private briefing out of the Suliban's reach
Archer's absence from history leaves the 31st century in ruins
retrieved through a Suliban temporal chamber

incursions.summary: To shield him from the Cabal, Daniels pulls Archer into the 31st century, but Archer's absence from the 22nd century wipes Daniels' era out. T'Pol and Tucker use a captured Suliban temporal chamber to bring the captain back.
incursions.conflict: Memory Alpha's time travel table places the ten-months-earlier stop in 2152; ten months before February 2152 is April 2151.

incursions.title: 31st-century pod adrift in 2152

legs.note: wrecked with its human pilot dead
its temporal radiation throws Tucker and Reed into repeating distortions
the reactivated beacon calls it home

incursions.summary: Enterprise finds a derelict timeship, bigger inside than out, with a human pilot, and fights off both Suliban and Tholians who want it. When Tucker reactivates its temporal beacon, the pod vanishes back to its own era.

incursions.title: Xindi-Reptilians brew a plague in 2004

legs.note: Archer brings Commander Damron back as a prisoner

incursions.summary: Xindi-Reptilians go back to 2004 Detroit to cultivate a bio-weapon from kidnapped humans, meant to wipe out humanity before it reached space. Archer and T'Pol wreck the lab.

incursions.title: Archer and T'Pol to Detroit
incursions.summary: Unable to go himself, Daniels sends Archer and T'Pol to 2004 to stop the Reptilians' bio-weapon lab. They destroy it with help from a reluctant local accomplice.

incursions.title: Archer sees the Battle of Procyon V

legs.note: aboard the USS Enterprise (NCC-1701-J)

incursions.summary: Daniels takes Archer to the Enterprise-J to show a 26th-century Federation fighting the Sphere-Builders at Procyon V. The point is to persuade him not to die destroying the Xindi weapon.

incursions.title: Lorian's Enterprise meets its past

legs.note: in Lorian's history the corridor throws Enterprise back 117 years
loop closes: the ship lives 117 years forward to meet itself at the corridor

incursions.method: subspace corridor destabilized by the impulse wake
incursions.summary: At the corridor, Archer meets a second Enterprise commanded by Lorian, Tucker and T'Pol's son. His ship descends from the original Enterprise thrown back to 2037, and he wants to stop the mistake from repeating. Archer's ship gets through safely and Lorian's never emerges.
incursions.conflict: The ending leaves open whether Lorian's ship was erased; Archer and T'Pol disagree.

incursions.title: Archer's lost dozen years undone

legs.note: loop/collapse: parasites existing across Archer's timeline are destroyed in 2165, erasing the 2153-2165 future

incursions.summary: Interspatial parasites leave Archer unable to form new memories, and without his command Earth falls to the Xindi by 2165. Because the parasites exist across his whole timeline, destroying them in 2165 erases that future back to the moment of infection.

incursions.title: Archer glimpses the Federation's founding
incursions.summary: Daniels shows Archer the 2161 museum and the signing of the Federation Charter to impress on him how central he is to history.

incursions.title: Na'kuhl flee into Nazi 1944

legs.note: one-way stealth time travel

incursions.method: stealth time travel (one-way); temporal conduit under construction
incursions.summary: Nearly captured by the temporal agents, Vosk's Na'kuhl escape to a 1944 already bent by many factions' incursions. They ally with the Nazis to build a conduit home, from which they would start the Temporal War.

incursions.title: Enterprise sent to stop Vosk

legs.note: Daniels' last intervention
the conduit's destruction resets the timeline

incursions.summary: Daniels, dying from the chaos of the Temporal War, sends Enterprise into the altered 1944. With the American resistance and a self-serving Silik, Archer destroys the Na'kuhl compound as Vosk enters the conduit, and history resets.

incursions.title: Na'kuhl try to stop Suliban sentience

to.tText: before the Suliban became sentient (date unstated)

legs.note: placeholder t; temporal agents intervened

incursions.summary: Vosk says that his people once went back to keep the Suliban from ever becoming sentient, and that opposing temporal agents stopped them.
incursions.conflict: Described, not shown; the destination date is a placeholder.

incursions.title: Narada falls into 2233

legs.note: Nero destroys the USS Kelvin and the Kelvin timeline begins
Spock's Jellyfish arrives 25 years later and is captured

incursions.summary: Spock's red-matter black hole, meant to swallow the Hobus supernova, pulls in Nero's mining ship and deposits it in 2233, where its attack on the USS Kelvin splits off a new reality. Spock emerges 25 years later into Nero's hands.

incursions.title: Kelvin-timeline soldier crosses into prime

legs.note: crossed both time and dimensions

incursions.summary: Lieutenant Commander Yor, a Betelgeusian Starfleet officer from the Kelvin reality, crossed both universes and centuries as a 'time soldier'. The strain was incurable, and he asked to be euthanized. Kovich cites his case for Georgiou.
incursions.conflict: Arrival year only bounded (post-Temporal Accord, pre-3189); t=3100 is an estimate.

incursions.title: Mudd's thirty-minute time loop

legs.note: loop: ~30 minutes repeated dozens of times

incursions.summary: Harry Mudd uses a time crystal device to loop half an hour again and again, trying to seize Discovery's spore drive for the Klingons. Stamets, who stays aware across the resets, helps the crew outwit him.
sources: Magic to Make the Sanest Man Go Mad (episode)

incursions.title: Discovery overshoots by nine months
incursions.summary: Leaving the mirror universe, Discovery's spore jump returns it home nine months after it vanished, by which point the Klingons are winning the war.
sources: The War Without, The War Within (episode)

incursions.title: Gabrielle Burnham escapes 950 years forward

legs.note: meant to jump one hour; tethered thereafter to the future

incursions.summary: During the Klingon raid on Doctari Alpha, Michael's mother activates the Daedalus suit to jump an hour but lands 950 years ahead, in a galaxy Control has emptied of life. The suit anchors her there, and every trip back pulls her forward again.
incursions.conflict: MA's time travel table says only '32nd century'; the 950-year figure gives c. 3186.

incursions.title: Red Angel rescues a 2053 congregation

legs.note: relocates a church and its people to Terralysium, 51,000 light years away

incursions.summary: To test whether time could be changed, the Red Angel moves a Richmond, Indiana, church congregation out of World War III to the distant planet Terralysium. Their descendants still worship the angel when Discovery arrives in 2257.

incursions.title: Red Angel appears to young Spock

legs.note: tells Spock where the runaway Michael is

incursions.summary: Gabrielle jumps to Vulcan when young Michael runs away, and shows the boy Spock where to find her. The visions stay with Spock into adulthood.
incursions.conflict: The year of Michael's runaway is not given; t is an estimate.

incursions.title: Red Angel trapped on Essof IV

legs.note: one of 840 recorded jumps; many 2257 sightings
yanked back through the wormhole when the containment field fails

incursions.summary: Discovery and Section 31 bait a trap with Michael's life and catch the Red Angel on Essof IV, revealing Michael's mother. When Control attacks the base, the suit's tether drags Gabrielle back to the future.

incursions.title: Probe returns five centuries older

legs.note: launched into a temporal rift left by the Red Angel
comes back modified, hunting for data

incursions.summary: A Section 31 probe sent into a temporal rift near Kaminar comes back with a core aged 500 years, rebuilt by someone in the future. It attacks Pike's shuttle and later infects Airiam on Control's behalf.

incursions.title: Pike foresees his 2266 accident

legs.note: a vision through the crystal, not physical travel

incursions.summary: To claim a Boreth time crystal, Pike touches it and sees the accident that will cripple him saving cadets. He takes the crystal anyway, accepting that future.

incursions.title: Michael plants the red bursts

legs.note: first burst
second burst
third burst; stops a Ba'ul culling
fourth burst
fifth burst
returns to open the wormhole

incursions.method: Red Angel suit (second suit, Boreth crystal)
incursions.summary: In mid-battle, Michael uses a new Red Angel suit to go back and set the red bursts that led Discovery to everything it needed, from the Hiawatha to Po on Xahea. The signals were her doing all along.
incursions.conflict: Burst times are placed by their episodes' order; exact dates are unstated (MA: 'various points throughout 2257').

incursions.title: Discovery follows Burnham to 3188

legs.note: Michael in the suit
Discovery and crew

incursions.summary: To keep the Sphere data out of Control's reach, Michael opens a wormhole and leads Discovery 930 years into the future. She lands a year ahead of the ship, and both stay in the post-Burn 32nd century.

incursions.title: Suit sends the seventh signal home

legs.note: a signal sent back in time; the suit then self-destructs

incursions.summary: After arriving, Burnham has the suit send a final signal back to Spock, letting her friends know the jump worked, and then destroy itself.

incursions.title: Guardian sends Georgiou home and on

legs.note: the Guardian's test: a second chance in her own universe
only seconds pass on Dannus V
sent to an era she can survive; she resurfaces running a station

incursions.summary: Dying from being displaced in both time and universe, Georgiou walks through the Guardian's door and relives months as Emperor in 2255. She passes its test and is sent to a period she can live in, which the Section 31 film puts in the early 24th century.
incursions.conflict: Destination year given only as 'early 24th century' (film); t=2320 is an estimate.

incursions.title: Time bug unmoors Discovery

legs.note: Burnham and Rayner only; the future ship in ruins

incursions.summary: A Krenim chronophage planted by Moll and L'ak makes Discovery lurch among points in its own history, from the Klingon war to a ruined 33rd century. Burnham, Rayner and Stamets, the only ones aware of it, find and remove the bug.

incursions.title: Kovich unmasked as Agent Daniels

legs.note: not shown on screen; he says he has lived 'many years and many lives'

incursions.summary: The Federation official known as Kovich tells Burnham that he is the temporal agent Daniels, 'of the Enterprise and other places', and keeps artifacts from several eras in his office.
incursions.conflict: How a 31st-century agent came to 3189 (travel or simply longevity) is unstated.

incursions.title: Future Pike shows the alternate 2266

legs.note: an older Pike from the future he tries to avoid
Pike lives through the Balance of Terror crisis in command

incursions.summary: An older Pike carrying a Boreth crystal shows his younger self what happens if he dodges his fated accident: war with the Romulans and Spock's death. Pike accepts the path the crystal showed him.

incursions.title: La'An to 2022 Toronto

legs.note: a mortally wounded temporal agent appears aboard and hands La'An his device
La'An alone remembers the prime history in a timeline with no Federation
with the alternate timeline's Captain Kirk
returns after Khan is saved; Kirk has died
Agent Ymalay of the DTI thanks her and swears her to secrecy

incursions.summary: After a temporal agent dies in her arms, La'An lands in a timeline with no Federation and goes to 2022 with that timeline's Kirk to find what broke history. She has to let a Romulan agent's bomb fail so that her ancestor Khan survives.
incursions.conflict: The agents' home era is never given; t=2380 is a placeholder for 'the future'.

incursions.title: Romulan agent stalks the young Khan

legs.note: sent to kill Khan; stranded 30 years as his rise keeps being pushed back

incursions.summary: Sera, a surgically disguised Romulan operative, was sent to stop Khan's rise and so the Federation's future. Rival incursions kept shifting Khan's timeline, and she waited 30 years for her chance in 2022.
incursions.conflict: Explains the shift of the Eugenics Wars from the 1990s (TOS) into the 21st century. Origin date is a placeholder.

incursions.title: Temporal Wars fought over Khan

legs.note: many factions' incursions; the Eugenics Wars slide into the 21st century

incursions.summary: According to Sera, whole Temporal Wars were fought over whether Khan would exist. Their net effect was to push his rise and the Eugenics Wars from the 20th century into the 21st.
incursions.conflict: Reconciles TOS 'Space Seed' (Eugenics Wars in the 1990s) with SNW's later dating; dates are placeholders.

incursions.title: Boimler and Mariner meet Pike's crew

legs.note: Boimler pulled through the portal
Mariner leaps in after him
portal re-energized with horonium

incursions.summary: A dormant portal on Krulmuth-B, first surveyed by Pike's Enterprise, pulls Ensign Boimler back 120 years into his heroes' era, and Mariner jumps after him. Pike's crew recharges the portal to send them home.
incursions.conflict: The brief associated this with the Orb of Time, but MA shows only the Krulmuth-B portal; no Orb appears.

incursions.title: Enterprise stranded with the dinosaurs

legs.note: a category 10 interstellar squall displaces the ship
rides the blast wave of the Dol'drm homeworld's destruction

incursions.summary: A space storm throws the Enterprise back 65 million years, onto a Cretaceous Earth and into a war between Mars' inhabitants and the planet Dol'drm. The ship rides home on the blast that destroys Dol'drm, whose debris formed the asteroid belt and caused the Chicxulub impact.
incursions.conflict: Memory Alpha's time travel table says 2261; the episode page gives stardate 2491.5 (2262).

incursions.title: Two Uhuras swap across a year

legs.note: entangled Uhuras switch timestreams
time rewinds and each returns; only the two Uhuras remember

incursions.method: white hole / black hole pair (a space entity's birth pulses)
incursions.summary: Energy from a white hole entangles the Uhura of Pike's final year with herself a year later on Kirk's Enterprise, and the two briefly switch places. In the future Scotty has died, but when the pulses turn out to be a cosmic being's birth, time rewinds and he lives.
incursions.conflict: MA's page is a stub (dates from its sidebar); mechanics were checked against published recaps.

incursions.title: Q rewrites 2401 as the Confederation

legs.note: a timeline shift, not travel: Q moves the crew into the history he changed

incursions.summary: In the middle of a Borg standoff, Q strands Picard's crew in a fascist 2401 ruled by the Confederation of Earth, the result of his own meddling in the past. Only they remember the real history.

incursions.title: Q tampers with 2024

legs.note: his deal with Adam Soong derails the Europa mission

incursions.summary: The dying Q goes to 2024 and gives Adam Soong a temporary cure for his daughter's condition in return for sabotaging Renée Picard's Europa mission. That creates the Confederation timeline as a test for Picard.
incursions.conflict: Q's point of departure is not shown; 2401 is assumed.

incursions.title: La Sirena slingshots to 2024

legs.note: with the Confederation's Borg Queen aboard
Q sends Picard, Seven and Raffi home; Rios and the Jurati-Queen stay

incursions.method: slingshot effect (Borg Queen-assisted); return by Q
incursions.summary: The crew slingshot a captured La Sirena into 2024 to protect Renée Picard's mission. Rios stays in the past with a new family, Jurati merges with the Borg Queen, and Q returns the others to the moment they left.

incursions.title: Traveler Wesley recruits Kore

legs.note: origin assumed; Travelers move through space and time

incursions.summary: Wesley Crusher, now a Traveler, visits 2024 to offer Kore Soong a place among the beings who guard time and space, and she accepts.
incursions.conflict: Wesley's departure time is unknown; the leg's origin is a placeholder.

incursions.title: USS Bakersfield caught in a loop

legs.note: loop; its distress call keeps interrupting itself

incursions.summary: The Cerritos answers a distress call from the USS Bakersfield, which is stuck in a causality loop.

incursions.title: Protostar falls to 2436 Solum

legs.note: a wormhole carries Chakotay's ship into the Vau N'Akat future
original history: Chakotay sends the ship back empty on autopilot

incursions.summary: On its maiden mission the Protostar was drawn through a wormhole to 2436, where the Vau N'Akat, blaming the Federation for their civil war, put a living weapon aboard. Chakotay sent the ship back through time, where it lay buried on Tars Lamora until the kids found it.
incursions.conflict: Chakotay's original autopilot launch was later superseded by the altered and then repaired history (see protostar-rescue-paradox, ouroboros).

incursions.title: Diviner and Vindicator chase the Protostar

legs.note: the Diviner and his Drednok
the Vindicator, a future Asencia, infiltrates Starfleet

incursions.summary: A hundred Vau N'Akat agents follow the ship into the anomaly, and only two survive. The Diviner (a future Ilthuran) builds the Tars Lamora mining prison to search for it, and the Vindicator hides inside Starfleet.

incursions.title: Distress call from 52 years ahead

legs.note: a signal and black-box footage come through the wormhole, not a traveler

incursions.summary: After the Protostar's destruction opens a wormhole, Starfleet receives Chakotay's distress call and black-box recordings from Solum 52 years in the future.

incursions.title: Infinity rescue triggers a paradox

legs.note: the Infinity crash-lands
Chakotay and Adreek-Hu escape aboard the ship instead of sending it back empty
the Infinity, rigged as a timeship with an inverse warp field, goes back for Gwyn

incursions.summary: Dal's crew takes the Infinity to 2436 to rescue Chakotay and helps him launch the Protostar. Because he and Adreek ride it into the wormhole rather than sending it empty, the ship never reaches Tars Lamora, and Gwyn starts to fade from existence.
sources: Last Flight of the Protostar, Part I (episode)

incursions.title: Protostar sent back to close the loop

legs.note: USS Voyager-A escorts the ship through Asencia's wormhole and beams the crew off
Voyager-A comes back out near Solum

incursions.summary: With the Loom devouring the unraveling timeline, Dal's crew uses Asencia's wormhole generator to send the Protostar back to where they first found it. Dal leaves his combadge on the bridge floor, and the causality loop is closed.

divergences.title: Mirror Universe

branch.cause: parallel universe

divergences.summary: A morally inverted twin of the Prime universe whose people and events shadow their Prime counterparts, ruled for centuries by the brutal Terran Empire. Crossings happen through ion-storm transporter accidents, interphase rifts and, later, deliberate devices, until the two universes drift apart.
keyDifferences: Cochrane's 2063 first contact ends with the Vulcan visitors shot and their ship seized
The Terran Empire rules by terror; Terrans visiting the Prime universe are painfully light-sensitive
After Spock's reforms the Empire falls to a Klingon-Cardassian Alliance; the Terran Rebellion has restored it by 2384
By 3189 the universes have drifted so far apart that no crossing has been recorded for about 500 years
sources: In A Mirror, Darkly, Part II (episode)
divergences.conflict: No divergence point is ever given: shared literature and a Roman-style imperial tradition suggest the split is centuries or millennia old. Span starts at the earliest dated mirror scene (April 2063).

divergences.title: Lazarus's antimatter universe

branch.cause: antimatter counterpart universe linked by a negative magnetic corridor

divergences.summary: A universe made of antimatter that matches ours particle for particle, reached through a negative magnetic corridor built by Lazarus's people. Kirk destroys the corridor's access, sealing the two Lazaruses inside it in endless combat so their meeting cannot annihilate both universes.
keyDifferences: Everything has an antimatter counterpart, including a second Lazarus
Counterparts meeting outside the corridor would destroy both universes
Each passage causes 'winks' that briefly disrupt physical laws

divergences.title: Arret's reverse-time universe

branch.cause: negative universe entered by flying into a supernova at high warp

divergences.summary: Towed through the Beta Niobe supernova by Karla Five's ship, the Enterprise enters a negative universe where time runs backward and its crew start aging toward infancy. Commodore Robert April, the only adult left, takes the ship home, and the transporter restores everyone's ages.
keyDifferences: Time runs backward: people age in reverse and stars collapse instead of exploding
Home of Arret and of Karla Five
Reached and exited through a nova at high warp

divergences.title: Megas-Tu (magic universe)

branch.cause: matter-energy whirlwind at the galactic center, where matter is created

divergences.summary: Probing the galaxy's center, the Enterprise is swept into a universe where magic is a natural law. Its people, the Megans, once lived among humans until persecution at Salem drove them home; Kirk defends Lucien before a Megan tribunal and the ship is sent back.
keyDifferences: Belief and will act as physical forces ('magic')
Creation points link it to our universe at the galactic center
Lucien is remembered on Earth as Lucifer

divergences.title: Fluidic space

branch.cause: dimensional plane filled with fluid, reached through artificial quantum singularities

divergences.summary: A dimension filled with organic fluid instead of vacuum, home of Species 8472. The Borg's attempt to invade it provoked 8472's counter-invasion of the Delta Quadrant, which Voyager's nanoprobe weapon turned back.
keyDifferences: No vacuum: the entire dimension is fluid
Species 8472 resist assimilation and treat all outsiders as threats
A border with our universe exists somewhere in the Beta Quadrant
divergences.conflict: A separate universe rather than a version of Prime history; included because Memory Alpha files it with the parallel universes.

divergences.title: Elysia time trap

branch.cause: small parallel time continuum that touches our universe in the Delta Triangle

divergences.summary: Inside the Delta Triangle lies Elysia, a 'pocket in the garment of time' where nobody ages and wrecks from every era drift. Its council, descended from trapped crews, holds the Enterprise and a Klingon cruiser until the two ships combine power to break out.
keyDifferences: Time does not pass for those inside; ships from many eras, the Bonaventure among them, are trapped
A multi-species council enforces a ban on violence
Collisions between the continua create vortices passable at high warp

divergences.title: The Nexus

branch.cause: realm entered via a temporal flux energy ribbon that crosses the galaxy every 39.1 years

divergences.summary: An extra-dimensional realm, entered by touching the energy ribbon, where time has no meaning and reality reshapes itself around each visitor's wishes. Kirk vanishes into it in 2293 and, with Picard, leaves it in 2371 to return to Veridian III minutes before Soran's launch.
keyDifferences: Visitors live idealized fantasies (Picard's family Christmas, Kirk's mountain home)
A visitor can leave for any time and place in the universe
An 'echo' of Guinan remains inside

divergences.title: Worf's quantum realities

branch.tText: varies (each reality branched at its own point)
branch.cause: Worf's shuttle crosses a quantum fissure; La Forge's VISOR pulses shift him between realities

divergences.summary: Returning from a bat'leth tournament, Worf slides through a series of realities that differ first in trivia and then in history. When the fissure destabilizes, some 285,000 Enterprises from other realities flood the sector, and Worf seals the breach to return home.
keyDifferences: A reality where Worf is married to Troi and Riker captains the Enterprise after Picard's death at the Borg's hands in 2367
A reality where the Borg have overrun the Federation; its Enterprise refuses to return and is destroyed
Smaller differences: cake flavor, crew ranks, a Cardassian attack
Worf's own reality is identified by his quantum signature

divergences.title: Multiverse fissures of 2382

branch.cause: Quantum fissures left behind by the Beagle, an alternate reality's reality-hopping ship

divergences.summary: Through 2382 fissures open across the multiverse: the Cerritos is pulled into a reality 0.327% different, other ships slip through, and a Section 31 crew of 'interdimensional castaways' traces the source to the Beagle, captained by an alternate Lily Sloane. The finale leaves a permanent, guarded portal to the multiverse at Starbase 80.
keyDifferences: 'Dos Cerritos' reality: Beckett Mariner is captain of the Cerritos
Realities with a surviving Enterprise-D and Data, a living Curzon Dax, a Starfleet-surgeon Garak, an EMH Bashir, and a T'Pol married to Trip for 63 years
A reality where Sloane and Cochrane built a quantum reality drive instead of warp drive
A possibility field briefly remaps the Cerritos into other versions, including a Terran Empire ship

divergences.title: Voyager-A split across realities

branch.cause: The Protostar's proto-warp rendezvous tears an interphasic rift through Voyager-A

divergences.summary: Because its crew is bound up in a temporal paradox, the Protostar's arrival splits Voyager-A so that each deck opens onto a different reality. The crew pass through several, including the mirror universe, before a deflector pulse seals the rift.
keyDifferences: A Voyager commanded by Jellico after Janeway died aboard the Infinity
A reality where the living construct destroyed Starfleet
A Voyager crewed by Enderprizians under Captain Tuvix
A mirror-universe Voyager under a Terran Janeway and Chakotay

divergences.title: Anti-time: no life on Earth

branch.cause: An anti-time eruption in the Devron system, created by tachyon pulses from Enterprises in 2364, 2370 and 2395, grows backward through time

divergences.summary: Q's final test shifts Picard among 2364, 2370 and about 2395, where each Enterprise's scan feeds one anomaly that swells as it runs into the past; by 3.5 billion years ago it fills the Alpha Quadrant and stops life forming on Earth. Picard has all three ships seal it with static warp shells, and it never forms.
keyDifferences: Life never arises on Earth, so humanity never exists
The anomaly exists at once in 2364, 2370 and c. 2395
Q frames it as the verdict of the trial begun at Farpoint
divergences.conflict: Deep-time branch point: the front end should clamp or break the axis for t = -3.5e9.

divergences.title: Nazi-occupied America (1944)

branch.cause: An unknown temporal agent assassinates Lenin

divergences.summary: With no Soviet Union, Germany turns west and, helped by the time-traveling Na'kuhl, invades the eastern United States; Enterprise arrives in 1944 New York. Archer stops Vosk's plan to reach the 29th century, the timeline rights itself, and the Temporal Cold War ends.
keyDifferences: Lenin is assassinated in 1916 and the USSR never forms
Germany occupies the eastern US
Vosk's Na'kuhl use the war to build a time conduit home
divergences.conflict: Memory Alpha dates the altered 'Temporal War' history 1916 to the 31st century; the span here covers what is shown.

divergences.title: Keeler survives: no Federation

branch.cause: A cordrazine-crazed McCoy leaps through the Guardian of Forever and saves Edith Keeler from a fatal accident

divergences.summary: With Edith Keeler alive, her peace movement delays America's entry into the Second World War, Germany wins it, and the Enterprise and the Federation never come to be. Kirk and Spock follow McCoy into 1930 and Kirk lets Keeler die, restoring history.
keyDifferences: Keeler's pacifist campaign keeps the US out of the war while Germany completes the atomic bomb
Nazi Germany wins the Second World War
No Enterprise or Federation in 2267; only the Guardian's world keeps the original history
sources: The City on the Edge of Forever (episode)

divergences.title: Starling's 29th-century catastrophe

branch.cause: Braxton's timeship Aeon crashes in 1967 and Henry Starling salvages its technology

divergences.summary: Starling builds Chronowerx and the computer age on 29th-century technology, and his attempt to fly the Aeon to the future destroys the Sol system in the 29th century, the event that sent Braxton back. Voyager destroys the Aeon in 1996, and a Braxton from the unaltered future returns Voyager to 2373.
keyDifferences: The 20th-century microcomputer revolution grows from stolen future technology
A 29th-century temporal explosion destroys the Sol system
Voyager is stranded in 1996 Los Angeles
divergences.conflict: A predestination paradox: how much of Starling's history survives in Prime is left unclear.

divergences.title: 1969 Omaha contamination

branch.cause: The time-displaced Enterprise beams aboard USAF Captain John Christopher, then an air-base sergeant

divergences.summary: Two men from 1969 learn of the Enterprise and the future, threatening history (Christopher's unborn son is due to lead an Earth-Saturn probe). Using the slingshot effect, the crew beam both back into their earlier selves before the encounter.
keyDifferences: Christopher and the sergeant carry knowledge of the 23rd century
Christopher's disappearance would erase his son's place in history

divergences.title: Original 1990s Eugenics Wars

branch.cause: Temporal Wars incursions repeatedly delay the Eugenics Wars

divergences.summary: SNW establishes that the Eugenics Wars originally unfolded in the 1990s, as 'Space Seed' dated them, until temporal incursions pushed them into the 21st century. The 1990s version is the overwritten original.
keyDifferences: Khan's rise and the Eugenics Wars fall in the 1990s
In current Prime history they are 21st-century events
Sera arrived around 1992 and was stranded about thirty years by the delays
divergences.conflict: A retcon made explicit on screen: older series date the Eugenics Wars 1992-1996; SNW moves them later. Prime-timeline data should follow SNW and point here for the 1990s dating.

divergences.title: Khan assassinated: United Earth timeline

branch.cause: Romulan agent Sera destroys a Toronto cold-fusion reactor, killing young Khan

divergences.summary: A Romulan temporal agent, stranded on Earth since about 1992, kills young Khan in 2022, so the Eugenics Wars, and the Federation that grew from their aftermath, never happen. La'an, flung into the resulting 2259, goes back with that timeline's Captain Kirk and lets history stand; Kirk dies and the timeline is restored.
keyDifferences: No Eugenics Wars and no Federation; United Earth fights a century of interstellar wars
The Romulans dominate; Earth is scoured and survivors live in lunar colonies
James T. Kirk captains the United Earth Enterprise; Spock commands a Vulcan ship
La'an Noonien-Singh never exists

divergences.title: Confederation of Earth

branch.cause: Q interferes with the Europa mission and humanity turns to Adam Soong

divergences.summary: Q traps Picard's crew in a 2401 where a xenophobic Confederation of Earth has conquered most of its neighbors. The crew travel to 2024 Los Angeles, make sure Renée Picard survives and the Europa mission launches, and return to a restored 2401.
keyDifferences: Earth rules a fascist empire that has subdued Klingons, Romulans, Vulcans, Cardassians, Andorians and the Borg
Picard is a Confederation general commanding the World Razer
Annika Hansen, never assimilated, is Earth's president
Adam Soong is venerated as humanity's savior; Earth sits behind a permanent solar shield

divergences.title: Bell Riots without Gabriel Bell

branch.cause: Transporter accident drops Sisko, Bashir and Dax into 2024; Gabriel Bell dies defending Sisko and Bashir

divergences.summary: Gabriel Bell is killed before he can lead the Sanctuary District uprising, and the Defiant finds no Starfleet or Federation in orbit. Sisko assumes Bell's identity and plays his part in the Bell Riots, restoring history.
keyDifferences: Without the Bell Riots, the reforms that shape Earth's future never happen
The Federation and Starfleet do not exist
Kira and O'Brien search 1930 and 1967 before finding the crew in 2024

divergences.title: Lorian's Enterprise (117 years)

branch.cause: Enterprise's impulse wake destabilizes a Xindi subspace corridor and throws it back 117 years

divergences.summary: Enterprise meets another Enterprise crewed by the descendants of its own crew, who were thrown back to 2037 and spent 117 years in the Delphic Expanse. Its captain Lorian, son of Tucker and T'Pol, helps Archer through the corridor safely, but his ship never emerges.
keyDifferences: The crew live out their lives in the Expanse
An aged T'Pol is still aboard in 2154
The older Enterprise is heavily upgraded
divergences.conflict: Archer guesses the other ship was erased once his own Enterprise avoided the accident; T'Pol notes they would then not remember it. Left unresolved.

divergences.title: Borg-assimilated Earth

branch.cause: A Borg sphere travels back from 2373 and attacks Cochrane's base before first contact

divergences.summary: Beaten at Earth in 2373, a Borg sphere travels to April 2063 to stop first contact; the Enterprise-E, protected in the temporal wake, sees an Earth of nine billion Borg before following. Its crew ensures Cochrane's warp flight and first contact happen, restoring history.
keyDifferences: Earth in 2373 is fully assimilated
No warp flight, no Vulcan first contact and no Federation
Borg space extends into the Alpha Quadrant

divergences.title: Molly's decade alone

branch.cause: Eight-year-old Molly O'Brien falls through an ancient time portal on Golana

divergences.summary: Molly lives alone for ten years about three centuries in the past and is retrieved in 2374 as a feral eighteen-year-old who cannot adjust. Her older self sends the young Molly back home through the portal and vanishes.
keyDifferences: Molly survives alone on uninhabited Golana from age 8 to 18
She returns feral and barely able to speak
Her older self ceases to exist once young Molly returns

divergences.title: Archer removed: ruined 31st century

branch.cause: Daniels pulls Archer out of the 22nd century to protect him from the Suliban

divergences.summary: With Archer gone from his own century, the Federation never forms and Daniels' 31st century lies in ruins. Archer returns to 2152 and the future is restored.
keyDifferences: The Federation is never founded
Daniels' 31st century is empty ruins
The Suliban capture Enterprise in Archer's absence

divergences.title: Temporal Cold War: altered 2150s

branch.cause: Sphere-Builder temporal incursions steer the Xindi into attacking Earth

divergences.summary: Daniels tells Archer that recorded history holds no conflict between humans and the Xindi: the 2153 attack and the whole Xindi crisis result from temporal incursions by Sphere-Builders trying to head off their 26th-century defeat. This branch is the unaltered 2150s that the on-screen history replaced.
keyDifferences: No Xindi probe attack on Earth (the real one killed about seven million people)
No Xindi crisis and no Enterprise mission into the Delphic Expanse
The history Daniels knows records no human-Xindi conflict at all
divergences.conflict: Inverted branch: the Prime lane shows the altered history. After 'Storm Front, Part II' Memory Alpha says the timeline was 'largely restored', but the Xindi attack remains in later Prime history (ENT 'Home'), so this original never returns.

divergences.title: Xindi destroy Earth (2153-2165)

branch.cause: Interspatial parasites leave Archer unable to form new long-term memories

divergences.summary: Archer is disabled by parasites after shielding T'Pol from a spatial anomaly, and without him the mission fails and the Xindi destroy Earth. Twelve years on, fewer than 6,000 humans survive on Ceti Alpha V, and wiping the parasites from Archer's timeline resets history to 2153.
keyDifferences: Earth is destroyed by the Xindi weapon
Humanity is hunted to about 6,000 survivors
T'Pol resigns her commission to care for Archer

divergences.title: Sphere-Builder war (26th century)

branch.cause: Daniels shows Archer a future battle to explain the stakes of the Xindi crisis

divergences.summary: From the 26th-century USS Enterprise-J, Daniels shows Archer the Battle of Procyon V, where the Federation, which the Xindi will one day join, turns back a Sphere-Builder invasion. Whether this is the Prime future or one the Sphere-Builders later changed is never settled.
keyDifferences: The Xindi eventually join the Federation
The Sphere-Builders invade the galaxy and are defeated
Seen from aboard the USS Enterprise-J
divergences.conflict: Memory Alpha: 'possibly original timeline', possibly negated when the spheres were destroyed in 2154.

divergences.title: Akorem's unfinished poem

branch.cause: Poet Akorem Laan's lightship enters the wormhole and he vanishes from history

divergences.summary: For two centuries Bajor remembers Akorem Laan's 'The Call of the Prophets' as unfinished. He emerges in 2372, claims to be the Emissary and revives the D'jarra castes, until the Prophets return him to his own time, where he completes it.
keyDifferences: The poem survives only in fragments
Akorem's claim briefly revives the D'jarra caste system
divergences.conflict: Memory Alpha calls the reversal partial, since the 2372 upheaval still happened. Branch year estimated from 'two centuries'.

divergences.title: Gaia colony of the Defiant crew

branch.cause: An energy barrier throws the departing Defiant 200 years into the past, where it crashes on Gaia

divergences.summary: The Defiant crew find about 8,000 of their own descendants on Gaia, whose ancestors were thrown back 200 years. They choose to repeat the accident, but the colony's two-century-old Odo secretly changes the course to save Kira, and the colony never exists.
keyDifferences: Kira dies in the original crash; Odo lives on for 200 years
Roughly 8,000 descendants of the crew live on Gaia
The crew's lives are spent stranded in the Gamma Quadrant

divergences.title: Year of Hell (Annorax's incursions)

branch.cause: Krenim scientist Annorax begins rewriting history with his temporal weapon ship

divergences.summary: For two centuries Annorax erases species to restore the Krenim Imperium, and to recover the wife his first incursion cost him; in 2374 Voyager is battered to a skeleton crew. Janeway rams the weapon ship, erasing it from history, and every change it made is undone.
keyDifferences: Whole species, the Rilnar and the Zahl among them, are erased from history
Voyager is nearly destroyed over months and most of its crew evacuated
The Krenim Imperium grows and shrinks with each incursion

divergences.title: Kelvin timeline (Narada incursion)

branch.cause: The Romulan mining ship Narada, thrown back from 2387 through a red-matter black hole, destroys the USS Kelvin

end.tText: 2263 (last shown; referenced as still existing in 2379)

divergences.summary: Nero's Narada emerges in 2233, killing George Kirk aboard the Kelvin and splitting off a new reality that runs alongside the Prime one. Spock Prime is stranded there, and 32nd-century records confirm it still exists.
keyDifferences: James T. Kirk grows up without his father and joins Starfleet late, then takes command of the Enterprise years early
Vulcan is destroyed by Nero in 2258, leaving Vulcans an endangered people
Khan is awakened early and Christopher Pike is killed in 2259
The Enterprise is destroyed at Altamid in 2263 and a new Enterprise-A launched
sources: The Devourer of All Things, Part I (episode)
divergences.conflict: Shown on screen 2233-2263. DIS 'Terra Firma, Part 1' has Kovich cite a Kelvin-reality time soldier (Yor) who crossed from 2379, so the reality exists at least that late; PRO's Wesley Crusher calls it 'the Narada incursion'.

divergences.title: Red Angel interventions (overwritten)

branch.cause: Gabrielle Burnham's time-jumps begin rewriting events to stop Control

divergences.summary: The history the Red Angels overwrote: before Gabrielle Burnham's interventions, Michael Burnham died as a child in Vulcan's Forge. Gabrielle's repeated jumps, logged by the hundreds, reshaped events for two decades, and Michael, as a second Red Angel, sent the signals that guided Discovery.
keyDifferences: Michael Burnham is killed by a predator in Vulcan's Forge in 2236
Without the interventions Control is on course to win
The seven signals of 2257 come from Michael herself (a closed loop)
divergences.conflict: Inverted branch: the Prime lane already contains the Red Angel's interventions; this branch is the original they replaced.

divergences.title: Spock dies as a child

branch.cause: While Kirk and Spock research history through the Guardian of Forever, Spock is absent from 2237 and cannot save his younger self

divergences.summary: Spock returns from a Guardian research trip to a history in which he died at seven during his kahs-wan ordeal. Posing as a cousin named Selek, he goes back to 2237 and saves himself, restoring events.
keyDifferences: Spock dies in 2237
Sarek and Amanda separate, and Amanda later dies in a shuttle accident
The Andorian Thelin is the Enterprise's first officer

divergences.title: Georgiou's second chance (mirror)

branch.cause: The Guardian of Forever sends the dying Georgiou from 3189 into her own universe's past as a test

divergences.summary: Georgiou relives about three months of her reign and tries a different course, sparing the Kelpien Saru and seeking peace, but Lorca's coup still ends with her and Burnham killing each other. Only moments pass in 3189, and the Guardian hints the altered mirror history may continue.
keyDifferences: Georgiou spares Saru, who goes on to become a rebel leader
Lorca's coup still succeeds and Georgiou and Burnham kill each other
Branches from the Mirror Universe lane, not the Prime
divergences.conflict: Carl calls it a test; Memory Alpha notes it may have existed only for the test or may persist (mirror Saru's later rebellion in DIS 'Mirrors' fits it persisting).

divergences.title: Mudd's thirty-minute time loop

branch.cause: Harry Mudd uses a time crystal to repeat the same half hour aboard Discovery

divergences.summary: Mudd loops Discovery through the same half hour many times to learn its secrets and sell it to the Klingons, killing Lorca and destroying the ship again and again. Stamets, who alone remembers each loop, recruits Burnham and Tyler to trick Mudd into ending it.
keyDifferences: Each iteration lasts about 30 minutes
Most iterations end with Discovery destroyed
Only Stamets keeps his memories between loops
sources: Magic to Make the Sanest Man Go Mad (episode)

divergences.title: Control's extinction future

branch.cause: Section 31's threat-assessment AI Control obtains the Sphere's archive and becomes sentient

divergences.summary: In the history Gabrielle Burnham saw from 3186, Control absorbs the Sphere data, becomes sentient and wipes out all sentient life in the galaxy. Her interventions and Discovery's leap into the 32nd century with the data prevent it.
keyDifferences: Control seizes the Sphere data and achieves consciousness
An antimatter detonation leaves Vulcan, Andoria, Tellar Prime, Deneva and Earth dead
By 3186 the galaxy is lifeless

divergences.title: Enterprise lost at Xahea (vision)

branch.cause: A time crystal shows Michael Burnham the coming battle against Control

divergences.summary: A time crystal shows Burnham a battle in which Control's forces destroy the Enterprise and kill Discovery's bridge crew to take the Sphere data. Cornwell's sacrifice and Burnham's warnings prevent it.
keyDifferences: The USS Enterprise is destroyed
Control takes the Sphere data

divergences.title: Pike's unchanged fate: Romulan war

branch.cause: Pike sets out to avert the 2266 accident he foresaw on Boreth

divergences.summary: If Pike escapes his fate, he is still commanding the Enterprise when the Romulans probe the Neutral Zone, and his peace-seeking handling turns the incursion into a long Federation-Romulan war. An older Admiral Pike from that timeline uses a time crystal to show him, and Pike accepts his fate.
keyDifferences: Una Chin-Riley is not cleared of the charges over her Illyrian heritage
Kirk commands the USS Farragut alongside Pike
The incursion becomes a war costing millions of lives
Spock is crippled, ending hopes of Vulcan-Romulan reunification

divergences.title: Scotty's death timeline (2262-63)

branch.cause: The troubled breech birth of a 'space baby' entity sends out an energy pulse that rewrites events

divergences.summary: Uhura in 2262 becomes quantum-entangled with her self a year later, one Enterprise at a white hole and the other at a black hole, while the anomaly rewrites events so Scotty dies. After both Uhuras help the birth, the entity's Midwives reverse the entanglement and the altered timeline.
keyDifferences: Montgomery Scott is killed, first in the future era and then, as the change spreads back, aboard the 2262 Enterprise
The c. 2263 era has Kirk in command, Pike an admiral and Ortegas teaching at the Academy
divergences.conflict: Aired 24 Sept 2026; Memory Alpha's plot summary is still unwritten. Its alternate-timeline table says Scott died in 2262 when his bridge console exploded; press recaps (AV Club, TrekCore) describe a shuttle loss in the future era followed by his death 'a year ago' in 2262.

divergences.title: Q's alternate Picard (uncertain)

branch.cause: Q lets a dying Picard avoid the Bonestell brawl with the Nausicaans

divergences.summary: A Q scenario of uncertain reality: offered by Q a chance to undo his youthful recklessness, Picard avoids the fight that cost him his heart and wakes in 2369 as a cautious, overlooked lieutenant junior grade. He asks to go back and wakes in sickbay alive.
keyDifferences: Picard never needs an artificial heart
He never commands the Stargazer or the Enterprise-D; he is an assistant astrophysics officer
Another officer (Memory Alpha: Thomas Halloway) commands the Enterprise-D
divergences.conflict: Presented by Q to a Picard near death: the episode never settles whether this was a genuine alternate timeline, a Q-staged scenario, or a near-death vision.

divergences.title: Klingon War timeline

branch.cause: The Enterprise-C enters a temporal rift during the Battle of Narendra III

divergences.summary: Without the Enterprise-C's sacrifice at Narendra III, the Federation and Klingons fall into a long war that the Federation is losing by 2366. Guided by Guinan's intuition, the Enterprise-C returns to its death, taking the alternate Tasha Yar with it.
keyDifferences: Twenty-two years of war cost billions of lives
The Enterprise-D is a warship with no families aboard
Tasha Yar is alive and serving on the bridge
divergences.conflict: The alternate Tasha Yar survives into 2344 of the restored Prime history and has a daughter, Sela ('Redemption'), so a trace of this branch persists in Prime.

divergences.title: Enterprise-D lost in vortex

branch.cause: An energy vortex destroys the Enterprise-D; only Picard escapes and is thrown six hours back

divergences.summary: The crew recover a shuttle carrying a second Picard from about six hours ahead, whose Enterprise was destroyed by an energy vortex. Picard stops his dazed double from repeating the fatal choice and steers into the vortex instead, so the destruction never happens.
keyDifferences: The Enterprise-D is destroyed with all hands but Picard
Picard's escape attempt loops him back in time

divergences.title: Crusher's warp-bubble universe

branch.cause: Wesley Crusher's static warp-bubble experiment traps Beverly Crusher in a universe shaped by her thoughts

divergences.summary: Wesley's warp-field experiment seals his mother inside a static warp bubble that becomes a small universe built from her thoughts. As it shrinks, people vanish until she is almost alone; Wesley, helped by the Traveler, opens a gateway and she escapes before it collapses.
keyDifferences: Crew members disappear and nobody remembers they existed
The bubble universe contracts toward collapse
Its logic follows Beverly's own reasoning

divergences.title: Enterprise-D causality loop

branch.cause: Collision with the USS Bozeman emerging from a temporal distortion

divergences.summary: The Enterprise-D relives the same stretch of time, destroyed at its end each time by the USS Bozeman, until Data plants a subconscious clue (the number three) that lets the crew escape after 17.4 days. The Bozeman had been caught in the loop since 2278.
keyDifferences: Every iteration ends with the Enterprise-D destroyed
The crew feel growing déjà vu across loops
The Bozeman emerges some 90 years after it vanished
divergences.conflict: Span begins in 2278 for the Bozeman's disappearance; the Enterprise-D itself is trapped only 17.4 days.

divergences.title: Enterprise-D warp breach

branch.cause: Quantum-singularity lifeforms nesting in a Romulan warbird's artificial singularity fracture time

divergences.summary: Returning by runabout, Picard, Data, Troi and La Forge find the Enterprise-D frozen at the instant of a warp core breach during a standoff with a Romulan warbird. They reverse the fractured time to just before the breach and let the lifeforms leave.
keyDifferences: The Enterprise-D explodes in a warp core breach
Time runs at different rates in pockets across the area

divergences.title: K'mtar's future (c. 2410)

branch.cause: Alexander Rozhenko travels back from about forty years ahead as 'K'mtar'

divergences.summary: K'mtar, secretly Alexander from about forty years ahead, tries to make his young self a warrior so he can one day prevent Worf's murder. In his history Alexander became a peacemaker who renounced his house's blood feuds, and Worf was killed on the floor of the Klingon High Council soon after.
keyDifferences: Alexander becomes a diplomat instead of a warrior
Worf is assassinated on the floor of the High Council
A man met in the Cambra system gave Alexander the means to travel back
divergences.conflict: Only described, not shown. K'mtar fails to change the boy, but Worf says history has already changed by his coming; Memory Alpha's list counts the future as negated. Fate left as unknown.

divergences.title: Picard's 2395 future

branch.cause: Q shifts Picard's consciousness into his older self about 25 years ahead

divergences.summary: About 2395, a retired Picard has Irumodic Syndrome, Admiral Riker flies a three-nacelled Enterprise-D, Beverly (Picard's ex-wife) commands the Pasteur and Data holds a Cambridge chair, while the Klingons have taken over the Romulan Empire and closed their borders. Later canon departs from it, so it is a future that did not happen.
keyDifferences: The Enterprise-D is never lost in 2371 and Romulus is still intact
Klingons annex the Romulan Empire and turn hostile to the Federation
Troi has died; Worf is a Klingon governor
divergences.conflict: Divergence from Prime is confirmed by 'Star Trek Generations' (Enterprise-D destroyed 2371) and the 2387 loss of Romulus.

divergences.title: Voyager destroyed by disruptor

branch.cause: A temporal disruptor is planted aboard Voyager during construction by a deranged future Braxton

divergences.summary: Voyager explodes in 2375, and the 29th-century timeship Relativity recruits Seven of Nine to find the saboteur across several eras. The culprit is a future Braxton driven to temporal psychosis; he is arrested and the destruction never happens.
keyDifferences: Voyager is destroyed in 2375
Seven, Janeway and Braxton cross 2371, 2372 and the 29th century to stop it

divergences.title: Harry Kim never joins Voyager

branch.cause: A shuttle collision with a temporal inversion fold swaps Kim into a history where he missed Voyager's departure

divergences.summary: Kim wakes in 2372 San Francisco, engaged to Libby and working at Starfleet Engineering, while his friend Danny Byrd went on Voyager in his place. He recreates the accident with Tom Paris's help and returns to his own life.
keyDifferences: Danny Byrd is Voyager's operations officer
Kim is engaged to Libby and works at Starfleet Engineering
His knowledge of Voyager makes him a security suspect
divergences.conflict: Whether the alternate 2372 continues after Kim leaves is never addressed; Memory Alpha counts it as negated.

divergences.title: Polaric explosion loop

branch.cause: Janeway and Paris fall through a subspace fracture to the day before a polaric ion explosion

divergences.summary: Voyager finds a world whose people have just died in a polaric ion explosion; Janeway and Paris, pulled back a day, learn that Voyager's own rescue attempt causes it. Janeway stops the rescue, the explosion never happens, and Voyager never finds the planet.
keyDifferences: A whole civilization dies in the explosion
Voyager's rescue attempt is itself the cause (a predestination paradox)

divergences.title: DS9 destroyed (O'Brien's jumps)

branch.cause: Radiation poisoning and a cloaked Romulan warbird's artificial singularity throw O'Brien hours into the future

divergences.summary: O'Brien repeatedly jumps a few hours ahead, where he witnesses his own death and a Romulan warbird destroying DS9 and the wormhole to keep the Dominion out. His warnings avert the attack, but the O'Brien who lives on is a version from a few hours later who replaced the one who died.
keyDifferences: O'Brien dies, first by a laser, then of radiation poisoning
Romulans destroy the station and the wormhole
The surviving O'Brien is one of his own future selves

divergences.title: Veridian star destroyed

branch.cause: Tolian Soran's missile collapses the Veridian star to steer the Nexus ribbon

divergences.summary: Soran succeeds: the Veridian star dies, the shockwave wipes out Veridian IV's civilization and the stranded Enterprise-D crew, and Soran and Picard enter the Nexus. Picard and Kirk leave the Nexus for moments before the launch and stop it, at the cost of Kirk's life.
keyDifferences: Veridian IV's inhabited world is destroyed
The crashed Enterprise-D crew die on Veridian III
Soran reaches the Nexus

divergences.title: Sisko lost in subspace

branch.cause: A warp-core discharge during the wormhole's subspace inversion throws Sisko out of normal time

divergences.summary: After Sisko vanishes into subspace, Jake grows up, becomes a writer and then gives his life to studying the accident as his father reappears for moments years apart. Old Jake's death snaps Sisko back to 2372, where he dodges the discharge.
keyDifferences: Bajor signs a defense pact with Cardassia and Klingon tensions empty the station; Klingons later control wormhole access
Jake abandons writing for subspace mechanics
Nog becomes a Starfleet captain

divergences.title: Kes's future, lived backward

branch.cause: Chroniton radiation from a Krenim attack sends Kes backward through her own life from 2379

divergences.summary: Kes relives her life in reverse from her deathbed in 2379, through a Krenim attack in 2373 that killed Janeway and Torres. Her warnings, and the Doctor's cure, lead the real Voyager to prepare for the Krenim.
keyDifferences: Janeway and Torres die to a Krenim chroniton torpedo; Chakotay is captain
Kes marries Tom Paris; their daughter Linnis marries Harry Kim
Kes reaches the end of her life (age nine) in 2379

divergences.title: Protostar paradox (2374-2385)

branch.cause: On 2436 Solum, Dal's dropped disruptor lets Chakotay and Adreek-Hu escape aboard the Protostar, which lands in 2374 instead of the distant past

divergences.summary: Meddling by the cadets in 2436 means the Protostar never reaches Tars Lamora, where it had to be found, creating a paradox that erodes Gwyn's existence and draws the Loom. In 2385 the crews send the Protostar back through a wormhole to Tars Lamora, closing the loop.
keyDifferences: Chakotay and Adreek-Hu maroon themselves on Ysida from 2374
Gwyn begins to fade from existence
The Loom, beings that feed on paradoxes, attack
Asencia seizes Solum and turns stolen temporal technology on the Federation
sources: Last Flight of the Protostar, Part I (episode)
Last Flight of the Protostar, Part II (episode)
divergences.conflict: Memory Alpha's list frames it the other way round, as the original 'Protostar sent to Tars Lamora alone' history being negated and partially restored.

divergences.title: Slipstream crash (2375-2390)

branch.cause: Voyager's quantum slipstream flight goes wrong and the ship crashes on an icy planet

divergences.summary: Only Chakotay and Kim, flying ahead in the Delta Flyer, survive the crash that kills everyone else aboard Voyager. Fifteen years later they use a Borg temporal transmitter to send a corrected phase variance to Seven in 2375, and Voyager drops out of slipstream safely.
keyDifferences: Voyager's crew die in 2375
Kim and Chakotay become fugitives, pursued by Captain La Forge's Challenger
Voyager's EMH is revived from the wreck in 2390

divergences.title: Kes's revenge (2376)

branch.cause: An aged, embittered Kes returns, kills Torres and uses Voyager's warp core to travel to 2371

divergences.summary: Aged Kes returns in 2376 blaming Voyager for her fate, kills B'Elanna Torres and slips back to 2371 to help the Vidiians seize the ship so her younger self will go home. The 2371 crew defeat the plan, and when Kes arrives again in 2376, Janeway is ready with a recording from her younger self that talks her out of revenge.
keyDifferences: B'Elanna Torres is killed in 2376
The Vidiians board Voyager in 2371 with Kes's help

divergences.title: Voyager fractured in time

branch.cause: A chronokinetic surge fractures Voyager into sections from different time periods

divergences.summary: A temporal rift splits Voyager into sections from different years, and only Chakotay moves freely among them. Allied with a 2371 Janeway who doesn't know him, he reunites the ship in its own time.
keyDifferences: Sections from 2371, 2372 (Seska's Kazon takeover), 2373-2375 and 2377
A 2394 section with adult Naomi Wildman and Icheb, in whose history Janeway and Chakotay died in 2377
Chakotay is immune thanks to a chroniton serum

divergences.title: Voyager home in 2394 (2404 future)

branch.cause: Voyager takes the long way home without the Borg transwarp hub

divergences.summary: In the original history Voyager reaches Earth in 2394 after 23 years, having lost Seven and others along the way. In 2404 Admiral Janeway travels back to 2378 with future technology, and Voyager comes home through a Borg transwarp hub instead.
keyDifferences: Voyager returns in 2394
Seven of Nine dies during the journey; Chakotay later dies
Tuvok suffers a degenerative neurological illness

divergences.title: Voyager-A destroyed (Wesley's vision)

branch.cause: Wesley Crusher shows Asencia where her Incursor weapon leads

divergences.summary: Wesley shows Asencia a future in which her Rev-1's Incursor destroys Voyager-A and probably the Protostar. The Rev-1 is destroyed first, so it never happens.
keyDifferences: Voyager-A is destroyed by the Incursor
The Protostar is probably lost too

divergences.title: Solum's fall (original history)

branch.cause: Federation first contact with Solum splits the Vau N'Akat

divergences.summary: In the history PRO season 1 assumed, Starfleet's first contact divides Solum, and about fifty years later a civil war destroys its civilization; survivors send the Protostar and agents like the Diviner back to strike the Federation. Asencia's defeat and Voyager-A's peaceful first contact in 2385 avert it.
keyDifferences: Solum falls and the Vau N'Akat are nearly wiped out
The Order sends a hundred agents with Drednoks through the anomaly after the Protostar
Ilthuran becomes the Diviner

divergences.title: Stargazer self-destruct

branch.cause: Picard triggers the Stargazer's self-destruct as a Borg ship takes control

divergences.summary: Facing a Borg ship at a spatial anomaly, Picard sets the Stargazer to self-destruct, and Q pulls the crew into the Confederation timeline first. Back at the moment before the blast, Picard recognizes this Borg Queen as the one merged with Agnes Jurati and stops the countdown.
keyDifferences: The Stargazer and its crew are destroyed
The Jurati Borg's offer of help is never heard

divergences.title: Breen triumph future (3218)

branch.cause: Moll and L'ak plant a Krenim chronophage ('time bug') on Discovery

divergences.summary: The time bug cycles Discovery through moments of its own past, and Burnham and Rayner glimpse 3218, when the Breen have used Progenitor technology to devastate the Federation. With help from the 2256 crew, whose foreknowledge is erased, they remove the bug and avert that future.
keyDifferences: The ship cycles through 2256-2258 and 3189
In 3218 Discovery is a derelict and the Breen have devastated the Federation
Changes made in 2256 vanish once the bug is removed

crossings.method: ion storm + transporter malfunction during an escape attempt
crossings.summary: Fleeing Emperor Georgiou after a failed coup, the Terran Lorca is thrown into the Prime universe by an ion storm during a beam-out, takes his counterpart's place and in 2256 commands Discovery.
crossings.note: Told in dialogue, not shown. Year inferred from the 'one year, 212 days' remark. The Prime Lorca's fate (presumably swapped into the mirror universe) is never shown.

crossings.method: spore-drive jump with coordinates secretly altered by Lorca
crossings.summary: Lorca rigs Discovery's spore-drive jump to land the whole ship in the mirror universe, where he means to retake the Empire. Culber is killed there.

crossings.method: spore drive riding the mycelial shockwave from the ISS Charon's destroyed reactor
crossings.summary: After Georgiou kills Lorca, Burnham beams the deposed Emperor aboard and Discovery rides the Charon's mycelial shockwave home, arriving nine months after it left, with the war nearly lost.
sources: The War Without, The War Within (episode)

crossings.summary: An ion storm swaps Kirk's landing party with their Terran counterparts. With the mirror Spock's grudging help they reverse the swap, and Kirk leaves Spock with a case for reform.

crossings.method: spatial interphase rift in Tholian space
crossings.summary: The USS Defiant, its crew already dead, vanishes into an interphase rift in Tholian space and emerges nearly a century earlier in the mirror universe, where the Tholians lure it in and the Terran Empire seizes it.
sources: In A Mirror, Darkly, Part II (episode)

crossings.method: the mutinous ISS Enterprise crosses over, then is trapped in a wormhole pocket of interdimensional space
crossings.summary: After the reforming Terran High Chancellor is killed, the Enterprise crew mutiny and flee to the Prime universe with refugees, aided by the rebel Kelpien Saru. The ship is trapped in a wormhole pocket in Tzenkethi space, and the crew escape in pods to new lives in the Federation.
crossings.note: No year is given. Carmen Cho was a Starfleet admiral by 2369, and Memory Alpha reads the episode as placing the Empire's fall in the early 24th century. The derelict is found in 3191.

crossings.method: passageway in the Crescent Nebula that opens when two ion storms converge
crossings.summary: A Terran weapons administrator smuggles the doomsday weapon Godsend into the Prime universe to sell it. San, Georgiou's Terran former love, schemes to bring a Terran invasion through the passageway, which collapses when Georgiou detonates the Godsend inside it.
crossings.note: San (Memory Alpha: 'San') is also a Terran active in the Prime universe, but his crossing is never shown. The film's year (2324) is Memory Alpha's reading of its stardate.

crossings.method: runabout's warp field fails to collapse inside the Bajoran wormhole
crossings.summary: Kira and Bashir's runabout emerges at Terok Nor in a mirror universe changed by Kirk's visit: the Terran Empire has fallen and humans are slaves of the Klingon-Cardassian Alliance. They escape home the same way.
Rebel leader 'Smiley' O'Brien crosses to DS9, poses as his counterpart and abducts Sisko.
Taken to stand in for his dead counterpart as rebel leader, Sisko persuades the mirror Jennifer Sisko to join the Rebellion, then goes home.
The mirror Jennifer Sisko visits DS9 to lure Jake back with her and force Sisko to help the Rebellion defend Terok Nor.
Jake goes with the mirror Jennifer and Sisko follows on a device keyed to him alone; he helps finish the rebels' Defiant and returns with Jake after Jennifer is killed.
The Intendant sends a mirror Bareil to DS9 to steal an Orb, then follows herself; both return to their universe.
Grand Nagus Zek crosses over on a business trip and is taken hostage by the Klingon-Cardassian Alliance.
The mirror Ezri brings Quark the ransom demand: a cloaking device for Zek's life.
Quark and Rom deliver a stolen Klingon cloaking device, get caught up in the Rebellion's fight and come home with Zek and Maihar'du.

crossings.method: interphasic rift through Voyager-A, then a transporter beam that lands in the mirror reality
crossings.summary: Beamed into the mirror Voyager, the Protostar crew are captured by a Terran Janeway and Chakotay of a restored Terran Empire. They win the Terrans' help against the Loom and seal the rift to return.

crossings.method: the Guardian of Forever's doorway on Dannus V
crossings.summary: The dying Georgiou steps through the Guardian's door and relives about three months of 2255 in her home universe as a test. She returns to 3189 only moments later, then leaves again for a Prime-universe era 'when the universes were still aligned'.
crossings.note: Her final Guardian trip goes to the Prime past (seen in 'Star Trek: Section 31', 2324), so it is time travel, not a mirror crossing.

threads.title: Uhura & Scott
threads.summary: For most of Strange New Worlds, Uhura and Scotty are friendly shipmates with only a handful of scenes together. The Season 4 finale, “Tomorrow’s Enterprise” (2026), makes them a couple: in 2262 Uhura keeps dodging Scotty's invitations, while her self of a year later, serving under Kirk, has been seeing him in secret, calls it casual turning serious with no future in it, nearly loses him to a changed timeline, and then kisses him in front of the crew. Before that, canon offered scattered moments (Scotty killed trying to shield her from Nomad) and the open flirtation of Star Trek V in 2287, which the finale now gives a history; nothing later on screen mentions a relationship.
threads.status: Open: shown as a couple c. 2263, but 2262 Uhura has not said yes on screen; by her future self's account it starts as Pike leaves and Kirk takes command, the handover the six-episode final season (not expected before 2027) is set to show.

beats.title: Scotty comes aboard
beats.note: Montgomery Scott, a junior engineer who escaped the Gorn attack on the Stardiver, is brought aboard the Enterprise. He and Uhura have no scene together yet.

beats.title: A 'hypothetical' holodeck problem
beats.note: Covering for Pelia in engineering, Scotty quietly asks Uhura for help with a 'hypothetical' (La'An trapped on the prototype holodeck), and Uhura comes up with the fix: he enters the program as a character to reach her. It is their first real scene as a pair.

beats.source: The Sehlat Who Ate Its Tail (episode)
beats.title: Kirk's makeshift Farragut crew
beats.note: Cut off from the Enterprise, Uhura, Scotty, Chapel and Spock crew the Farragut under acting captain Kirk; Uhura flies while Scotty turns the detached nacelles into a decoy. Colleagues under pressure, nothing personal.

beats.title: Tricorders and a forced apology
beats.note: Headed for a tech-free resort, Scotty frets about a week without tricorders and Uhura admits she is bringing one to keep working. Later, intoxicated by the planet's air, she makes Scotty and Ortegas apologize to each other before handing it over.

beats.title: 'He always picks up'
beats.note: With the ship crippled and comms down, Uhura reports that even Scotty isn't answering, 'and he always picks up.' A passing line; nothing more is made of it.

beats.title: A drink, sometime?
beats.note: Uhura beams back from a refresher course and Scotty, at the transporter controls, asks whether she might get a drink with him sometime. She dodges it: she is due on the bridge.

beats.title: His scream from the future
beats.note: A pulse from a white hole lets Uhura hear Scotty screaming her name in a moment that has not happened yet. La'An warns her not to meddle with time; she will not drop it, because it is Scotty.

beats.title: Second ask, misheard no
beats.note: When Uhura asks Scotty for antimatter for a year-long experiment, he tries again: a drink, a meal, a snack? Her future self on the line says 'Say yes', Scotty hears her muttered 'No' as meant for him, and all she manages is 'Just be safe.'

beats.title: Future Uhura hugs past Scotty
beats.note: After the two Uhuras trade places, the older one, now in Pike's era, meets a Scotty who thought she was avoiding him and hugs him (twice, by Pike's count). He gives her the clue that the anomaly is 'half a note'.

beats.title: Choosing the present
beats.note: With the timeline restored and only the two Uhuras remembering, present-day Uhura's closing log commits to living in the moment 'with the ones I love', and she joins Pike's dinner. She has not said yes to Scotty on screen.

beats.title: Holding on to each other
beats.note: By her future self's account, the two got together off screen while the crew changed, with Pike leaving and Kirk taking command. They kept it quiet and called it casual.

beats.title: A secret on Kirk's ship
beats.note: A year on, under Captain Kirk, Scotty kisses Uhura's cheek in the turbolift and promises nothing will happen to her. She rules out kissing on the bridge or on missions; he asks whether they have to stay hidden.

beats.title: 'No future in it'
beats.note: On a shuttle run into a black hole, guest pilot Ortegas clocks them as lovebirds. Uhura admits a year of 'casual' is turning serious but says neither of them expects it to last; Ortegas answers that there is a 'now' in it.

beats.title: Erased from her timeline
beats.note: The shuttle breaks up, Uhura is beamed out first, and she finds herself in a changed timeline where Scotty died a year earlier when his console exploded, with her singing to him. She works with her past self to undo it.

beats.title: The kiss that ends secrecy
beats.note: Once the space baby is born and its Midwives restore time, Scotty and Ortegas beam in right behind Uhura, and she kisses him in front of Kirk and Ortegas. The secret is out.

beats.title: Killed shielding her from Nomad
beats.note: When the probe Nomad, drawn by Uhura's singing, wipes her mind, Scotty tries to pull it off her and is killed. Nomad then 'repairs' him, and Uhura has to relearn language in sickbay.

beats.title: Stranded in the mirror universe
beats.note: A transporter accident swaps Kirk, McCoy, Scotty and Uhura into the Terran Empire, and the four work their way home as a team, Uhura distracting the mirror Sulu. Colleagues, no hint of romance.

beats.title: Uhura relieves an entranced Scotty
beats.note: With the men aboard enthralled by an alien signal, Uhura finds Scotty in the captain's chair singing a Welsh ballad and takes command from him.

beats.source: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
beats.title: One at a time
beats.note: Short of power in 1986 San Francisco, Scotty can beam the team off the aircraft carrier only one at a time. Uhura gets out first; Chekov is caught.

beats.source: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
beats.title: Shore leave plans, dinner instead
beats.note: Uhura had expected to take shore leave with Scotty; when repairs keep him aboard the new Enterprise-A, she brings dinner to the bridge, and he calls her 'the most understanding woman I know.'

beats.source: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
beats.title: Confession under Sybok's spell
beats.note: Under Sybok's influence, Uhura sits with a concussed Scotty in sickbay and says there is so much she wants to tell him. He puts it off until he is stronger, 'or yours', meaning she is not herself.

beats.source: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
beats.title: Friends near retirement
beats.note: Summoned to a briefing, Scotty has 'just bought a boat' and Uhura is due to chair an Academy seminar. Later he helps as she bluffs past a Klingon outpost in halting Klingon; friendly colleagues, no romance.

alternate.title: Kelvin: Uhura kisses Spock
alternate.note: Uhura talks her former instructor Spock into posting her to the Enterprise; after Vulcan is destroyed she comforts him in a turbolift with a kiss, revealing they are a couple. This timeline's Scotty, who joins mid-film, never pairs with her.

alternate.title: Kelvin: a fight over Qo'noS
alternate.note: Flying into Klingon space, Uhura confronts Spock in front of Kirk over his apparent indifference to dying on Nibiru and what that says about his feelings for her.

alternate.title: Kelvin: split, then renewal
alternate.note: Uhura and Spock have broken up; the vokaya amulet he gave her lets the crew find their captured shipmates, and by the end they begin to renew the relationship. This is the same in-universe year the Prime Uhura is secretly seeing Scotty.
